paras.zh: 截至 9 月 24 日，最初的雪崩释放出的能量相当于原子弹爆炸，由此产生的泥石流造成至少 1,400 人死亡，仍有 5,000 多人失踪。科学家称其为有记录以来最灾难性的地质灾害之一。

paras.en: But despite the magnitude of the event, it didn’t have to be so deadly.
paras.zh: 但尽管事件规模很大，但它并不一定如此致命。

paras.en: Survivors and scientists say that the fragility of Nepal’s early warning systems and the lack of coordinated community responses probably upped the number of lives lost. The disaster is spurring conversations about how Nepal should prepare for future glacier-related failures. Such events are becoming increasingly common across high mountain regions including the European Alps, Andes, Karakoram and the Himalaya. But because of its high slopes and steep valleys, says Christian Huggel, a geographer at the University of Zürich, “everything is much bigger in the Himalaya.”
paras.zh: 幸存者和科学家表示，尼泊尔早期预警系统的脆弱性和缺乏协调一致的社区应对措施可能增加了死亡人数。这场灾难引发了关于尼泊尔应如何为未来与冰川相关的故障做好准备的讨论。此类事件在欧洲阿尔卑斯山、安第斯山脉、喀喇昆仑山脉和喜马拉雅山等高山地区变得越来越普遍。但苏黎世大学地理学家克里斯蒂安·胡格尔表示，由于山坡高、山谷陡，“喜马拉雅山的一切都更大。”

paras.en: Predicting an event like Nepal’s rock-ice avalanche in advance is “likely impossible,” says Ashim Sattar, a cryosphere scientist at the Indian Institute of Technology in Bhubaneswar. Because events of such magnitude are rare, there isn’t a lot of existing data to go on.
paras.zh: 印度布巴内斯瓦尔理工学院的冰冻圈科学家阿希姆·萨塔尔表示，提前预测像尼泊尔岩冰雪崩这样的事件“可能是不可能的”。由于如此大规模的事件很少见，因此没有大量现有数据可供参考。

paras.en: Satellite images taken weeks before the avalanche show signs of cracks opening up, but those cracks are nothing special. “There are probably hundreds of cracks opening in the Himalaya,” Huggel says. It’s not clear which cracks pose a serious risk.
paras.zh: 雪崩前几周拍摄的卫星图像显示了裂缝出现的迹象，但这些裂缝并不特别。 “喜马拉雅山上可能有数百条裂缝，”胡格尔说。目前尚不清楚哪些裂缝会带来严重风险。

paras.en: Most current glacier monitoring in the Himalaya focuses on the threat of a glacial lake outburst flood, or GLOF. An influx of meltwater is increasing the size of highland lakes, which can suddenly burst and flood downstream villages. A mix of satellite monitoring, which can track the size of lakes, and on-the-ground field stations can warn of such hazards in advance. “If glacial lakes are forming rapidly, scientists can detect that a few weeks before possible outburst,” Huggel says. Even here, though, only 21 of some 40,000 glacial lakes across the Himalaya are actively monitored via on-the-ground stations.
paras.zh: 目前喜马拉雅山的大多数冰川监测都集中在冰川湖溃决洪水（GLOF）的威胁上。融水的涌入正在扩大高原湖泊的规模，这些湖泊可能会突然决堤并淹没下游村庄。卫星监测可以跟踪湖泊的大小，而地面站可以提前警告此类危险。 “如果冰川湖正在迅速形成，科学家们可以在冰川湖可能爆发前几周检测到，”胡格尔说。但即使在这里，喜马拉雅山上约 40,000 个冰川湖中也只有 21 个受到地面站的主动监测。

paras.en: Rock-ice avalanches are harder to predict, largely because it is difficult to study the fracture zone hidden beneath the surface and thus to know what volume of material will break off.
paras.zh: 岩冰雪崩更难预测，主要是因为很难研究隐藏在地表以下的断裂带，从而很难知道有多少物质会断裂。

paras.en: Despite these challenges, scientists have managed some similar avalanche predictions. In May 2025, a massive glacier collapsed in southwestern Switzerland, triggering an ice and rock avalanche that destroyed the village of Blatten. The possibility of the avalanche, which ended up being a tenth the size or smaller of the Nepal avalanche, was recognized by a local hazard observer who was assigned to monitor the mountains and knew them well.
paras.zh: 尽管面临这些挑战，科学家们还是做出了一些类似的雪崩预测。 2025 年 5 月，瑞士西南部的一座巨大冰川崩塌，引发冰雪崩塌，摧毁了布拉滕村。这次雪崩的规模最终只有尼泊尔雪崩的十分之一或更小，一位被派去监测山脉的当地灾害观察员认识到了这一可能性，他对山脉非常了解。

paras.en: “He observed something strange as the mountain seemed to move and alerted the local and district authorities,” Huggel says. They brought in various sensors and monitoring systems to measure the movement of the slope and executed a quick evacuation around a week in advance of the failure, saving hundreds of lives.
paras.zh: “当山似乎在移动时，他观察到了一些奇怪的现象，并向当地和地区当局发出了警报，”胡格尔说。他们引入了各种传感器和监控系统来测量斜坡的移动，并在故障发生前一周左右进行了快速疏散，挽救了数百人的生命。

paras.en: Whether similar local hazard observers could have spotted a potential disaster in Nepal and called on the necessary resources for early evaluation is far from clear. The terrain is difficult to access, and its location near the border between Nepal and China adds a layer of political complexity. “Monitoring these slopes is nobody’s job,” says Kshitij Dahal, a hydrologist at the University of Kansas in Lawrence who is originally from Nepal. Most of the monitoring in Nepal is reactive rather than anticipatory, he adds.
paras.zh: 类似的当地灾害观察员是否能够在尼泊尔发现潜在的灾害并呼吁必要的资源进行早期评估还远不清楚。该地区地形难以进入，而且其位置靠近尼泊尔和中国边境，这增加了政治的复杂性。 “监测这些斜坡不是任何人的工作，”来自尼泊尔的劳伦斯堪萨斯大学水文学家 Kshitij Dahal 说。他补充说，尼泊尔的大部分监测都是被动的，而不是预期的。

paras.en: Without the ability to predict such catastrophes, early warning systems are the primary line of defense. In the Himalaya, river gauge sensors are commonly deployed to warn of coming floods. These sensors monitor the water level in the river and send out an alarm if there is a substantial rise.
paras.zh: 如果没有能力预测此类灾难，早期预警系统就是主要的防线。在喜马拉雅山，通常部署河流测量传感器来警告即将到来的洪水。这些传感器监测河流的水位，如果水位大幅上涨就会发出警报。

paras.en: But these sensors, including the ones installed in Trishuli River, are primarily used for monsoon season flooding, when the water level tends to increase gradually. They transmit flood data every 10 minutes. Nepal’s flood hit with such sudden intensity that sensors located between nine and 100 kilometers from the avalanche site were wiped out before they could report high water.
paras.zh: 但这些传感器，包括安装在 Trishuli 河上的传感器，主要用于季风季节洪水，此时水位往往会逐渐上升。他们每 10 分钟传输一次洪水数据。尼泊尔的洪水来得如此突然，以至于距离雪崩地点 9 至 100 公里的传感器在报告高水位之前就被摧毁了。

paras.en: Other technologies are available or in development. Early warning systems that rely on seismometers might offer a workable solution. After Nepal’s massive earthquake in 2015, Basanta Raj Adhikari, an engineering geologist at the Tribhuvan University in Kathmandu, Nepal, and his team installed six seismometers along Bhotekoshi River in a nearby valley of Central Nepal.
paras.zh: 其他技术已经可用或正在开发中。依赖地震仪的预警系统可能会提供一个可行的解决方案。 2015 年尼泊尔大地震后，尼泊尔加德满都特里布万大学的工程地质学家 Basanta Raj Adhikari 和他的团队在尼泊尔中部附近山谷的 Bhotekoshi 河沿岸安装了 6 个地震仪。

paras.en: Placed a couple of kilometers above the riverbank, the sensors were intended to assess how long it took for the landscape to become stable again after such a major geological event. In July 2016, when a glacial lake in Tibet burst open, the resulting flood destroyed hydropower stations, highways and buildings — and produced distinct seismic signals picked up by those Bhotekoshi River sensors. Adhikari thinks that if such systems are set up to operate in real-time, they could detect and warn of floods in advance.
paras.zh: 这些传感器放置在河岸上方几公里处，旨在评估在发生如此重大的地质事件后，地貌需要多长时间才能恢复稳定。 2016 年 7 月，西藏的一个冰川湖决堤，由此引发的洪水摧毁了水电站、高速公路和建筑物，并产生了由博特科希河传感器接收到的独特地震信号。 Adhikari 认为，如果此类系统能够实时运行，它们就可以提前检测并警告洪水。

paras.en: Researchers studying seismic signals after historic and deadly flooding in western Germany’s Ahr Valley in 2021 also determined that seismic monitoring could have provided an early warning. The signals revealed details about the likely height of the water, the velocity of the sediment, the spread of the flood and the types of debris. Inexpensive seismic stations can cost somewhere around a couple thousand dollars, the researchers say, with some citizen-science seismographs available for costs below $500.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究 2021 年德国西部阿尔河谷历史性致命洪水后的地震信号时也发现，地震监测可以提供早期预警。这些信号揭示了有关水位可能高度、沉积物速度、洪水蔓延和碎片类型的详细信息。研究人员表示，廉价地震台的成本约为几千美元，一些公民科学地震仪的成本低于 500 美元。

paras.en: Putting eyes on the landscape is another approach. Ólafur Stitelmann, a geomonitoring expert at the Zürich-based company Geoprevent, deploys tools that can scan and monitor glaciers for deformations of millimeters per day or per hour. Some of these tools, including interferometric radars, camera systems and satellite-based navigation sensors, were used to assess the ice before the Blatten collapse, and they could form the basis of early warning systems.
paras.zh: 关注风景是另一种方法。 Ólafur Stitelmann 是苏黎世 Geoprevent 公司的地质监测专家，他部署的工具可以扫描和监测冰川每天或每小时的毫米变形。其中一些工具，包括干涉雷达、摄像系统和卫星导航传感器，被用来在布拉顿塌陷之前评估冰层，它们可以构成早期预警系统的基础。

paras.en: Stitelmann’s team is now working to deploy high-resolution cameras, weather stations, lake level sensors and water temperature sensors at two sites at risk from GLOFs in the state of Sikkim, India. Once a day, the data is sent via satellite to local authorities who can analyze conditions and take timely action if needed.
paras.zh: Stitelmann 的团队目前正致力于在印度锡金州两个面临 GLOF 风险的地点部署高分辨率摄像机、气象站、湖水位传感器和水温传感器。数据每天一次通过卫星发送给地方当局，地方当局可以分析情况并在需要时及时采取行动。

paras.en: Yet early warning systems are far from plug-and-play solutions, and they are too costly to deploy en masse. What works in the Alps may not automatically work in the Himalaya, in part because these systems need to be integrated into the local infrastructure. “If you have very good sensors but suddenly don’t have power to turn it on, then it’s worthless,” Stitelmann says. Similarly, there needs to be a network available to transmit the data that can trigger the warning. And every step needs to have backups, he adds.
paras.zh: 然而，预警系统远非即插即用的解决方案，而且大规模部署成本太高。在阿尔卑斯山有效的系统可能不会自动在喜马拉雅山有效，部分原因是这些系统需要集成到当地基础设施中。 “如果你有非常好的传感器，但突然没有能力打开它，那么它就毫无价值，”斯蒂特曼说。同样，需要有一个网络可用于传输可以触发警告的数据。他补充说，每一步都需要备份。

paras.en: It is important to have more than one sensor, says Huggel, who would complement any seismic stations with wire-based sensors stretching across the river. Installing backup sensors at different elevations could also buy crucial time if primary riverbank stations are wiped out.
paras.zh: 胡格尔说，拥有多个传感器非常重要，他可以用横跨河流的有线传感器来补充任何地震站。如果主要河岸站被摧毁，在不同海拔安装备用传感器也可以赢得关键时间。

paras.en: Such dream systems are expensive, ranging from tens of thousands of dollars to costs in the millions for a multi-sensor set of stations when the necessary infrastructure and backups are included, Stitelmann says. When the World Bank financed the setup of an early warning system downstream of a glacier lake, Tsho Rolpa in Nepal, in 1998, the cost was over a million dollars.
paras.zh: Stitelmann 表示，这样的理想系统非常昂贵，如果包括必要的基础设施和备份，多传感器站的成本从数万美元到数百万美元不等。 1998年，世界银行资助在尼泊尔Tsho Rolpa冰川湖下游建立预警系统，费用超过100万美元。

paras.en: In the case of Nepal, officials are discussing some relatively simple steps. One is putting backup sensors on the cliffs, since systems on bridges were quickly wiped out. Another is changing the design of river gauges so they transmit data once the water reaches a threshold level, rather than after a 10-minute interval.
paras.zh: 就尼泊尔而言，官员们正在讨论一些相对简单的步骤。一是在悬崖上安装备用传感器，因为桥梁上的系统很快就被摧毁了。另一个是改变河流水位计的设计，一旦水位达到阈值，它们就会传输数据，而不是每隔 10 分钟传输一次数据。

paras.en: Even if the technology works perfectly, there are social aspects to consider, including who decides when an alarm is issued, what message is delivered and how, and who coordinates evacuation. False warnings are also a problem, because people who have received them before may not trust that the next warning is genuine. “Technologies alone are no magical solutions,” Stitelmann says.
paras.zh: 即使该技术运行完美，也需要考虑社会方面的问题，包括由谁决定何时发出警报、传递什么消息以及如何传递，以及由谁协调疏散。虚假警告也是一个问题，因为之前收到过警告的人可能不相信下一个警告是真实的。 “仅靠技术并不是神奇的解决方案，”斯蒂特曼说。

paras.en: After GLOF events in the village of Lunana in Bhutan in 2019 and 2023, Sattar and his team interviewed residents about the community response. Although an automated siren had been installed in the region, it wasn’t triggered in either case. Locals instead relied on environmental cues including the sound of the river, ground vibrations and phone calls from friends and family to evacuate.
paras.zh: 2019 年和 2023 年在不丹卢纳纳村发生 GLOF 事件后，萨塔尔和他的团队采访了居民，了解社区的反应。尽管该地区安装了自动警报器，但两种情况都没有触发。相反，当地人依靠环境线索来疏散，包括河流的声音、地面震动以及朋友和家人的电话。

paras.en: Locals also reported being aware of the potential danger because of past flooding and ongoing government outreach. Sattar’s team also learned that disaster response could have been improved if the community had regular mock drills and if families prepacked evacuation bags with medicines, food, lights and warm clothes in case of an emergency.
paras.zh: 当地人还报告说，由于过去的洪水和持续的政府宣传，他们意识到了潜在的危险。萨塔尔的团队还了解到，如果社区定期进行模拟演习，并且家庭在紧急情况下预先装上药品、食物、灯光和保暖衣物的疏散袋，灾难应对能力可能会得到改善。

paras.en: In Nepal, many people probably lost their lives because of confusion and lack of awareness, says Pyakurel, the Dhunge Bazaar shopkeeper. For most, it was the biggest flood that they would have encountered in their lifetime. In July 2025, a glacial lake in Tibet burst open, leaving nine dead and 20 missing in Nepal, but it didn’t affect this area as dramatically. “Last year’s flood barely touched the bridge, so [we] assumed this flood wouldn’t reach high ground,” he adds.
paras.zh: Dunge Bazaar 店主 Pyakurel 表示，在尼泊尔，许多人可能因为混乱和缺乏意识而丧生。对于大多数人来说，这是他们一生中遇到的最大的洪水。 2025年7月，西藏的一个冰湖决裂，导致尼泊尔9人死亡、20人失踪，但对该地区的影响并没有那么严重。 “去年的洪水几乎没有触及桥梁，所以（我们）假设这次洪水不会到达高地，”他补充道。

paras.en: The disaster highlights the need for better education about the potential dangers and preparation so people can act quickly, says Sattar.
paras.zh: 萨塔尔说，这场灾难凸显出需要更好地了解潜在危险和做好准备，以便人们能够迅速采取行动。

paras.en: Stories of survival also offer insights into what matters most in an emergency. On the morning of August 26, Rajendra Dawadi, a principal at the Tribhuvan Trishuli Secondary School, received a verbal warning from another school staffer about rising waters upstream. Even without official confirmation, he acted instantly. He asked to ring the school bell, instructed teachers to evacuate classrooms, and called drivers carrying buses with students to head to higher ground — saving more than 900 students.
paras.zh: 生存故事还让我们深入了解紧急情况下什么才是最重要的。 8月26日上午，特里布万·特里舒利中学校长拉金德拉·达瓦迪收到另一名学校工作人员关于上游水位上涨的口头警告。即使没有得到官方确认，他也立即采取了行动。他要求按响学校钟，指示老师疏散教室，并呼叫载有学生的巴士司机前往地势较高的地方，从而拯救了 900 多名学生。

paras.en: It wasn’t a sophisticated system that made the difference in this case, but a quick decision to evacuate. “I thought that even if the warning turned out to be wrong, the worst it would cost us was one day of study,” Dawadi told the New York Times. “But taking it lightly could mean the loss of hundreds of lives.”
paras.zh: 在这起案件中，发挥作用的并不是复杂的系统，而是快速的疏散决定。达瓦迪告诉《纽约时报》：“我认为，即使这个警告最终被证明是错误的，最糟糕的结果就是让我们损失一天的学习时间。” “但掉以轻心可能意味着数百人丧生。”

articles.title: A medieval remedy could offer ideas for beating antibiotic resistance
articles.author: Hannah Thomasy

paras.en: A look one thousand years into the past is revealing clues about how to develop the bacteria-fighting drugs of the future.
paras.zh: 回顾一千年的过去，揭示了如何开发未来抗菌药物的线索。

paras.en: A concoction from a 10th century medical manuscript damaged cell membranes, altered the expression of disease-promoting genes and interfered with interbacterial communication when added to bacterial cultures, researchers report September 3 in mSphere. What’s more, three kinds of harmful bacteria developed resistance to the medicinal mixture much more slowly compared with conventional single-molecule antibiotics.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 9 月 3 日在 mSphere 上报告称，来自 10 世纪医学手稿的混合物在添加到细菌培养物中时会损坏细胞膜，改变致病基因的表达，并干扰细菌间的通讯。此外，与传统的单分子抗生素相比，三种有害细菌对药物混合物产生耐药性的速度要慢得多。

paras.en: “The difference is remarkable,” says Omar El-Halfawy, a microbiologist at the University of Regina in Canada who was not involved in the research.
paras.zh: “差异是显着的，”未参与这项研究的加拿大里贾纳大学微生物学家 Omar El-Halfawy 说道。

paras.en: This impaired ability to develop resistance may occur because the medieval medicine affects several bacterial targets, says Freya Harrison, a microbiologist at the University of Warwick in England. For bacterial colonies to survive, “they’ve potentially got to mutate multiple targets, and that’s difficult.”
paras.zh: 英国华威大学微生物学家弗雷娅·哈里森 (Freya Harrison) 表示，这种产生耐药性的能力可能会受到损害，因为中世纪药物会影响多种细菌靶标。为了让细菌菌落生存，“它们可能必须突变多个目标，这很困难。”

paras.en: The modern adaptation of the 10th century recipe (shown) involves combining garlic, onion, bovine bile and wine, then brewing the pungent mixture in a brass vessel for nine days.
paras.zh: 现代对 10 世纪配方的改编（如图所示）包括将大蒜、洋葱、牛胆汁和葡萄酒混合，然后在黄铜容器中将这种刺激性混合物酿造九天。

paras.en: Currently, antibiotic-resistant infections kill more than 1 million people each year. But humans have been battling the minuscule enemies that cause diseases like plague, leprosy and tuberculosis for millennia. Sometime in the 10th century, Anglo-Saxon scribes compiled several sometimes-dubious treatments into a medical text known as Bald’s Leechbook.
paras.zh: 目前，抗生素耐药性感染每年导致超过 100 万人死亡。但几千年来，人类一直在与引起鼠疫、麻风病和结核病等疾病的微小敌人作斗争。在 10 世纪的某个时候，盎格鲁撒克逊抄写员将几种有时可疑的治疗方法汇编成一本医学著作，称为《巴尔德的水蛭书》。

paras.en: In 2015, Harrison and a team of microbiologists and historians brewed a remedy from the Leechbook, called Bald’s eyesalve, in the lab. They mixed garlic, onion, bovine bile and wine in a brass vessel, then allowed it to stand for nine days. In laboratory tests, Bald’s eyesalve displayed surprisingly effective antimicrobial activity against both Staphylococcus aureus and its drug-resistant form, MRSA.
paras.zh: 2015年，哈里森和一群微生物学家和历史学家在实验室里根据水蛭书酿造了一种药物，称为秃头眼药水。他们将大蒜、洋葱、牛胆汁和酒混合在一个黄铜容器中，然后静置九天。在实验室测试中，Bald 的眼药对金黄色葡萄球菌及其耐药形式 MRSA 表现出令人惊讶的有效抗菌活性。

paras.en: This time, the scientists set out to determine how the eyesalve affected pathogens, measuring how the brew altered gene expression in bacterial cultures. After eyesalve treatment, hundreds of S. aureus genes were expressed differently, including ones related to cell membrane composition and disease-causing potential.
paras.zh: 这一次，科学家们着手确定眼药如何影响病原体，测量这种饮料如何改变细菌培养物中的基因表达。眼药治疗后，数百个金黄色葡萄球菌基因表达不同，包括与细胞膜组成和致病潜力相关的基因。

paras.en: The remedy also damaged bacterial membranes, a possibly lethal maneuver. Furthermore, very low concentrations of the eyesalve reduced S. aureus’ ability to create hardy antibiotic-resisting colony formations called biofilms. It also inhibited bacterial cell communication, which pathogens use to coordinate activities and become more harmful.
paras.zh: 这种疗法还会破坏细菌膜，这可能是致命的。此外，极低浓度的眼药水会降低金黄色葡萄球菌产生耐抗生素菌落形成（称为生物膜）的能力。它还抑制细菌细胞通讯，病原体利用这种通讯来协调活动并变得更加有害。

paras.en: Finally, the team dosed cultures of S. aureus and two other pathogens with increasing concentrations of the eyesalve or commonly used antibiotics to see how quickly resistance developed. After two weeks, the microbes often flourished despite exposure to eight to sixteen times the amount of the traditional antibiotic that had stymied their growth at the beginning. In contrast, they could only tolerate slightly higher eyesalve concentrations.
paras.zh: 最后，研究小组向金黄色葡萄球菌和其他两种病原体的培养物中加入浓度不断增加的眼药水或常用抗生素，以观察耐药性发展的速度。两周后，尽管接触的传统抗生素的量是一开始阻碍微生物生长的八到十六倍，但微生物仍然经常繁殖。相比之下，他们只能忍受稍高的眼药浓度。

paras.en: Harrison says she’s not expecting people to whip up their own batches of eyesalve to treat infections. “It would be really impractical to do that, and also potentially really unreliable and dangerous because it’s going to be so variable.”
paras.zh: 哈里森说，她并不指望人们自己制作一批眼药水来治疗感染。 “这样做确实不切实际，而且可能非常不可靠和危险，因为它会变得如此多变。”

paras.en: Instead, she says, researchers could recapitulate the eyesalve’s multipronged attack in a clinically suitable way with a lab-made cocktail containing a handful of the potion’s active ingredients. “Somewhere in there, there’s this combination of molecules that’s responsible for most of this effect — so, can we find out what they are?”
paras.zh: 相反，她说，研究人员可以用一种实验室制造的含有少量药水活性成分的鸡尾酒，以临床上合适的方式重现眼药水的多管齐下的作用。 “在那里的某个地方，有这种分子组合造成了大部分这种效应——那么，我们能找出它们是什么吗？”

articles.title: Exhaling may speed up reaction times
articles.author: RJ Mackenzie

paras.en: A sprinter’s first task is to react to the starting pistol. Now, a button-clicking experiment suggests that how quickly people respond to a cue may depend in part on whether they’re breathing in or out.
paras.zh: 短跑运动员的首要任务是对发令枪做出反应。现在，一项点击按钮的实验表明，人们对提示的反应速度可能部分取决于他们是吸气还是呼气。

paras.en: Volunteers’ reaction times were faster when they exhaled or held their breath compared with when they inhaled, researchers report September 28 in iScience.
paras.zh: 研究人员 9 月 28 日在《iScience》杂志上报告称，与吸气时相比，志愿者呼气或屏住呼吸时的反应速度更快。

paras.en: Ken Paller and Erika Yamazaki, then both cognitive neuroscientists at Northwestern University, made their discovery while studying breathing patterns to find treatments for sleep apnea. Yamazaki graduated from her PhD earlier this year.
paras.zh: 肯·帕勒（Ken Paller）和埃里卡·山崎（Erika Yamazaki）当时都是西北大学的认知神经科学家，他们在研究呼吸模式以寻找睡眠呼吸暂停的治疗方法时发现了这一点。山崎今年早些时候从博士学位毕业。

paras.en: Paller and Yamazaki determined how sleepy 35 volunteers were with a simple reaction-time test. The volunteers were tasked with clicking a button when an on-screen red square turned yellow.
paras.zh: Paller 和 Yamazaki 通过简单的反应时间测试确定了 35 名志愿者的困倦程度。志愿者的任务是当屏幕上的红色方块变成黄色时点击按钮。

paras.en: Yamazaki realized that, because the volunteers’ breathing was recorded through short tubes in the nose throughout the task, the researchers could also check whether inhaling or exhaling influenced reaction times.
paras.zh: 山崎意识到，由于在整个任务过程中志愿者的呼吸都是通过鼻子里的短管记录的，因此研究人员还可以检查吸气或呼气是否影响反应时间。

paras.en: Reaction times were, on average, 41 milliseconds faster during exhalation than during inhalation. This finding held regardless of how sleepy or alert the volunteers were.
paras.zh: 呼气时的反应时间比吸气时平均快 41 毫秒。无论志愿者有多困或多警觉，这一发现都成立。

paras.en: That might not sound like a huge difference, but Noah Lyles won the 2024 Olympic men’s 100-meter final by five thousandths of a second. Those 41 milliseconds would have made the difference between Lyles winning and finishing fourth.
paras.zh: 这听起来可能不是一个巨大的差异，但诺亚·莱尔斯 (Noah Lyles) 以千分之五秒的优势赢得了 2024 年奥运会男子 100 米决赛。这 41 毫秒将决定莱尔斯能否获胜和获得第四名。

paras.en: But the relationship between breath and brain appears to be complex. A 2016 study found that reaction times were faster during inhalation than exhalation in tests of recall and facial recognition. But these tasks differed from the hair-trigger change Paller and Yamazaki studied. Those tasks required more cognitive processing, Paller says, because they required the participants to judge whether, for example, a face look fearful or surprised, rather than waiting for a simple cue. “That may or may not have the same relationship with respiration.”
paras.zh: 但呼吸和大脑之间的关系似乎很复杂。 2016 年的一项研究发现，在回忆和面部识别测试中，吸气时的反应时间比呼气时更快。但这些任务与帕勒和山崎研究的一触即发的变化不同。帕勒说，这些任务需要更多的认知处理，因为它们要求参与者判断一张脸是否看起来害怕或惊讶，而不是等待一个简单的提示。 “这可能与呼吸有相同的关系，也可能没有。”

paras.en: The mechanism behind these findings isn’t clear, although Paller points to studies, like the one from 2016, that suggest our breath is synced to the ebb and flow of our brain waves.
paras.zh: 这些发现背后的机制尚不清楚，尽管帕勒指出，2016 年的一项研究表明，我们的呼吸与脑电波的潮起潮落是同步的。

paras.en: In a race decided by thousandths of a second, every factor matters, even a single breath.
paras.zh: 在千分之一秒决定胜负的比赛中，每一个因素都很重要，甚至是一次呼吸。

articles.title: Alzheimer's Might Actually Be a Third Type of Diabetes, Some Scientists Argue
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: You've probably heard of type 1 and type 2 diabetes, but did you know there's possibly a third option as well?
paras.zh: 您可能听说过 1 型和 2 型糖尿病，但您知道可能还有第三种选择吗？

paras.en: For just over two decades now, some scientists have argued that type 3 diabetes is an apt title for what happens in some cases of Alzheimer's.
paras.zh: 二十多年来，一些科学家一直认为 3 型糖尿病是对某些阿尔茨海默氏症病例的恰当称呼。

paras.en: Not all types of dementia are the same, but emerging evidence suggests that in at least some cases, impaired insulin signaling could be a form of neurodegeneration.
paras.zh: 并非所有类型的痴呆症都是相同的，但新出现的证据表明，至少在某些情况下，胰岛素信号传导受损可能是神经退行性疾病的一种形式。

paras.en: This specific metabolic issue may starve some brain cells of the energy they need to function, and that may ultimately lead to cognitive decline.
paras.zh: 这种特定的代谢问题可能会使一些脑细胞缺乏运作所需的能量，最终可能导致认知能力下降。

paras.en: Today, type 3 diabetes is an unofficial term for Alzheimer's, not a clinical diagnosis. But the idea is gaining traction.
paras.zh: 如今，3 型糖尿病是阿尔茨海默病的非官方术语，而不是临床诊断。但这个想法正在获得关注。

paras.en: Increasingly, evidence suggests that poorly controlled blood sugar may increase the risk of developing Alzheimer's.
paras.zh: 越来越多的证据表明，血糖控制不佳可能会增加患阿尔茨海默病的风险。

paras.en: In fact, impaired glucose or sugar metabolism tends to be one of the first changes detected among patients.
paras.zh: 事实上，葡萄糖或糖代谢受损往往是患者中首先发现的变化之一。

paras.en: "This relationship is so strong that some have called Alzheimer's "diabetes of the brain" or "type 3 diabetes"," explained a 2020 review on the topic.
paras.zh: “这种关系如此密切，以至于有些人将阿尔茨海默病称为“大脑糖尿病”或“3 型糖尿病”，”2020 年关于该主题的评论解释道。

paras.en: "While the specific mechanisms between AD and all forms of diabetes remain convoluted and unclear," the review added, "type 3 diabetes has the potential to provide a plethora of proactive and therapeutic strategies to current patients."
paras.zh: 该评论补充道：“虽然 AD 和所有形式的糖尿病之间的具体机制仍然复杂且不清楚，但 3 型糖尿病有可能为当前患者提供大量的主动治疗策略。”

paras.en: Insulin is a natural hormone used by the body to manage blood sugar levels. But as it turns out, it isn't just made by the pancreas.
paras.zh: 胰岛素是人体用来控制血糖水平的天然激素。但事实证明，它不仅仅由胰腺产生。

paras.en: The brain also makes insulin, and yet many experts, even those who research diabetes, remain unaware of that fact.
paras.zh: 大脑也会产生胰岛素，但许多专家，甚至那些研究糖尿病的专家，仍然没有意识到这一事实。

paras.en: Where this hormone is produced in the brain and what it actually does is still coming to light.
paras.zh: 这种激素在大脑中产生的位置以及它的实际作用仍然未知。

paras.en: In 2020, a study among mice found that insulin is made and released from several stress-sensing neurons in the hypothalamus.
paras.zh: 2020 年，一项针对小鼠的研究发现，胰岛素是由下丘脑的几个压力感应神经元产生和释放的。

paras.en: In the human brain, this region also shows the highest insulin levels.
paras.zh: 在人脑中，该区域也显示出最高的胰岛素水平。

paras.en: The hypothalamus is closely involved in thinking, memory, and learning, and it is a major target for Alzheimer's research.
paras.zh: 下丘脑与思维、记忆和学习密切相关，是阿尔茨海默病研究的主要目标。

paras.en: If diabetes of the brain turns out to be a real clinical disorder, then the hypothalamus may be the region that suffers most.
paras.zh: 如果大脑糖尿病被证明是一种真正的临床疾病，那么下丘脑可能是受影响最严重的区域。

paras.en: But we need more direct evidence of these insulin issues in neural tissue.
paras.zh: 但我们需要更直接的证据来证明神经组织中的这些胰岛素问题。

paras.en: In a recent postmortem study of patients who died with dementia, researchers at Cornell University found "massive" metabolic changes throughout the brain's tissue.
paras.zh: 在最近对死于痴呆症的患者进行的尸检研究中，康奈尔大学的研究人员发现整个大脑组织发生了“巨大”的代谢变化。

paras.en: "We saw metabolic changes linked to cellular energy, glucose metabolism, inflammation and fatty acids, all of which have been previously implicated in Alzheimer's disease," said Jan Krumsiek, assistant professor of computational genomics, in 2022.
paras.zh: 计算基因组学助理教授 Jan Krumsiek 在 2022 年表示：“我们看到了与细胞能量、葡萄糖代谢、炎症和脂肪酸相关的代谢变化，所有这些变化以前都与阿尔茨海默病有关。”

paras.en: What's more, this year, a postmortem study of three patients who died with Alzheimer's found brain tissue with more 'sugar decorations' than in healthy controls.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，今年对三名死于阿尔茨海默氏症的患者进行的尸检研究发现，他们的脑组织比健康对照组有更多的“糖装饰”。

paras.en: These sugary deposits indicate disrupted energy control in the brain, possibly linked to insulin.
paras.zh: 这些含糖沉积物表明大脑中的能量控制被破坏，可能与胰岛素有关。

paras.en: Type 1 diabetes is an immune disease that impacts insulin-producing cells, but type 3 diabetes appears to be an issue with glucose usage.
paras.zh: 1 型糖尿病是一种影响胰岛素生成细胞的免疫疾病，但 3 型糖尿病似乎与葡萄糖的使用有关。

paras.en: Some recent evidence suggests that in cases of dementia, brain cells lose the ability to handle glucose properly.
paras.zh: 最近的一些证据表明，在痴呆症的情况下，脑细胞会失去正确处理葡萄糖的能力。

paras.en: Similar to type 2 diabetes, these cells may show issues with insulin resistance, which helps regulate glucose levels.
paras.zh: 与 2 型糖尿病类似，这些细胞可能会出现胰岛素抵抗问题，而胰岛素抵抗有助于调节血糖水平。

paras.en: This mix between insulin resistance and a poor use of glucose is the very foundation behind type 3 diabetes.
paras.zh: 胰岛素抵抗和葡萄糖使用不当之间的这种结合是 3 型糖尿病背后的基础。

paras.en: A 2025 review recently explained that type 3 diabetes is not a clinical diagnosis but a conceptual framework to better understand how some forms of dementia are related to metabolism.
paras.zh: 最近的一篇 2025 年评论解释说，3 型糖尿病不是一种临床诊断，而是一个概念框架，可以更好地理解某些形式的痴呆症如何与新陈代谢相关。

paras.en: Alzheimer's is increasingly associated with metabolic dysfunction, particularly insulin resistance, and this could impair neuronal signaling and energy metabolism.
paras.zh: 阿尔茨海默病越来越多地与代谢功能障碍，特别是胰岛素抵抗相关，这可能会损害神经元信号传导和能量代谢。

paras.en: "This hypothesis has gained traction because epidemiological studies have observed an increased incidence of dementia, particularly Alzheimer's disease, among individuals with diabetes," the review explains.
paras.zh: 该评论解释说：“这一假设得到了广泛关注，因为流行病学研究发现糖尿病患者中痴呆症，特别是阿尔茨海默病的发病率有所增加。”

paras.en: Some researchers are critical of the term type 3 diabetes. They argue that there is insufficient evidence to definitively categorize Alzheimer's as a form of diabetes.
paras.zh: 一些研究人员对 3 型糖尿病一词持批评态度。他们认为，没有足够的证据将阿尔茨海默病明确归类为糖尿病的一种形式。

paras.en: Plus, they think it oversimplifies Alzheimer's, which is probably an umbrella term for a diversity of different disease types.
paras.zh: 另外，他们认为这过于简单化了阿尔茨海默病，阿尔茨海默病可能是多种不同疾病类型的总称。

paras.en: Both of those critiques could be true, and yet even still, the authors of the recent review argue that type 3 diabetes "represents a critical area of research, linking metabolic dysfunction with neurodegeneration."
paras.zh: 这两种批评都可能是正确的，但即使如此，最近这篇评论的作者仍然认为，3 型糖尿病“代表了一个关键的研究领域，它将代谢功能障碍与神经退行性疾病联系起来。”

paras.en: The prevalence of dementia can reach 24 percent in diabetic individuals over the age of 75, according to some estimates.
paras.zh: 据估计，75 岁以上的糖尿病患者中痴呆症患病率可达 24%。

paras.en: That's an association that deserves further investigation.
paras.zh: 这是一个值得进一步调查的关联。

paras.en: "Recognizing [type 3 diabetes] as a distinct clinical entity could transform the diagnosis and treatment of [Alzheimer's disease]," the 2025 review argues.
paras.zh: “认识到 [3 型糖尿病] 作为一个独特的临床实体可以改变 [阿尔茨海默氏病] 的诊断和治疗，”2025 年审查认为。

articles.title: Astronomers May Have Found a Planet in The Habitable Zone of The Hottest Star Yet
articles.author: Ivan Farkas

paras.en: Detecting planets outside of our Solar System mostly relies on measuring minute changes in the light of distant stars.
paras.zh: 探测太阳系外的行星主要依赖于测量遥远恒星光线的微小变化。

paras.en: If this were akin to finding a needle in a haystack, astronomers would delight. But it's more like distinguishing the glow of a firefly flitting in front of the nuclear brilliance of a hydrogen bomb.
paras.zh: 如果这类似于大海捞针，天文学家会很高兴。但这更像是辨别在氢弹的核光前面飞过的萤火虫的光芒。

paras.en: Impressively, astronomers have found more than 6,300 exoplanets so far using various methods.
paras.zh: 令人印象深刻的是，天文学家迄今为止已经使用各种方法发现了 6,300 多颗系外行星。

paras.en: They are a diverse menagerie of mouthwatering worlds, including one that seems to be emitting a weirdly tantalizing signal, as well as Earth-like analogs bathed in the crimson light of dim, blood-hued red dwarfs.
paras.zh: 它们是一个令人垂涎欲滴的多样化世界，其中包括一个似乎发出奇怪诱人信号的世界，以及沐浴在暗淡、血色红矮星的深红色光芒中的类似地球的类似物。

paras.en: Astronomers may have just made another milestone discovery in the search for intrinsically intriguing worlds: the hottest star to potentially host a habitable-zone planet, a giant world named HD 156295 b.
paras.zh: 天文学家在寻找本质上有趣的世界的过程中可能刚刚取得了另一个里程碑式的发现：最热的恒星可能拥有一颗宜居带行星，一个名为 HD 156295 b 的巨大世界。

paras.en: If confirmed, this would be the first known exoplanet in the habitable zone of a massive, A-type star, named HD 156295.
paras.zh: 如果得到证实，这将是第一颗位于 A 型大质量恒星（名为 HD 156295）宜居带内的系外行星。

paras.en: A-types shine bluish-white and can grow to about twice the mass and size of the Sun, 'burning' several thousand degrees hotter.
paras.zh: A型恒星发出蓝白色光芒，质量和大小可以增长到太阳的两倍左右，“燃烧”的温度要高出数千度。

paras.en: This naked-eye-visible star is around nine times brighter than the Sun, approaching 7,500 degrees Celsius (13,500 degrees Fahrenheit), and only around 140 light-years away.
paras.zh: 这颗肉眼可见的恒星的亮度是太阳的九倍左右，温度接近 7,500 摄氏度（13,500 华氏度），距离我们仅约 140 光年。

paras.en: But wait, there's more! The cosmos served us an infomercial-style BOGO on this specific star because it's also a Delta Scuti variable, meaning it pulsates in brightness so regularly that it doubles as a 'cosmic clock'.
paras.zh: 但是等等，还有更多！宇宙在这颗特定的恒星上为我们提供了电视广告风格的 BOGO，因为它也是一个 Delta Scuti 变星，这意味着它的亮度脉动如此规律，以至于它可以兼作“宇宙时钟”。

paras.en: As described in a recent paper published in The Astrophysical Journal, the astronomers sifted through nearly 16,500 Delta Scuti stars observed by NASA's Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), an electronic eye in the sky (four eyes, in fact) designed to expand our exoplanetary repertoire.
paras.zh: 正如最近发表在《天体物理学杂志》上的一篇论文所述，天文学家筛选了美国宇航局凌日系外行星勘测卫星 (TESS) 观测到的近 16,500 颗 Delta Scuti 恒星，TESS 是天空中的电子眼（实际上是四只眼睛），旨在扩展我们的系外行星库。

paras.en: Overall, the astronomers whittled down their selection to just nine star systems, one of which hosts the aforementioned exoplanet candidate HD 156295 b and eight of which host candidate brown dwarfs.
paras.zh: 总体而言，天文学家将他们的选择缩减为仅九个恒星系统，其中一个拥有上述的系外行星候选 HD 156295 b，其中八个拥有候选褐矮星。

paras.en: The potential planet may be about six times more massive than Jupiter and located almost 4 astronomical units (AU; the distance between the Sun and Earth) from its stellar parent, which it orbits in about 2,200 days – imagine waiting six years for your birthday and that free Applebee's mini-sundae!
paras.zh: 这颗潜在行星的质量可能是木星的六倍左右，距离其母恒星近 4 个天文单位（AU；太阳与地球之间的距离），绕母恒星公转一周约 2,200 天——想象一下，你等了六年才等到你的生日，然后苹果蜂的迷你圣代就免费了！

paras.en: As a result of the system's characteristics, HD 156295 b would receive around 60 percent of the solar irradiation that Earth receives from the Sun.
paras.zh: 由于该系统的特性，HD 156295 b 将接收到地球从太阳接收的约 60% 的太阳辐射。

paras.en: Notably, the researchers utilized a stellar sleuthing strategy called pulsation timing, which "uncovers systems that would be undetectable with any other observational technique," they explain.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，研究人员利用了一种称为脉动定时的恒星侦查策略，他们解释说，该策略“发现了任何其他观测技术都无法检测到的系统”。

paras.en: This technique tracks the tiny variations in the time it takes the star's light to reach us. Since HD 156295 pulsates at a steady rhythm, the researchers could tease out any slight alterations that may be caused by the gravitational influence of another body in the system, such as a planet.
paras.zh: 这项技术可以追踪恒星光线到达我们的时间的微小变化。由于 HD 156295 以稳定的节奏脉动，研究人员可以找出可能由系统中另一个天体（例如行星）的引力影响引起的任何轻微变化。

paras.en: The other eight celestial candidates around different Delta Scuti stars in this work may be brown dwarfs, odd bodies more massive than planets but not beefy enough to ignite hydrogen fusion à la stars, ranging from 25 to 59 Jupiter masses.
paras.zh: 这项工作中不同盾牌座δ恒星周围的其他八个天体候选者可能是褐矮星，这种奇怪的天体比行星还大，但不足以点燃恒星的氢聚变，质量范围为25到59木星。

paras.en: These also trace some Swing Your Partner Round and Round orbits, lasting approximately 1,100 to 2,800 days, making us much younger here (and also much smaller since we'd be crushed to pulp).
paras.zh: 这些也追踪了一些“摇摆你的伴侣”的循环轨道，持续大约 1,100 到 2,800 天，使我们在这里变得更年轻（而且也更小，因为我们会被压成肉泥）。

paras.en: The researchers estimate the odds that the exoplanet candidate HD 156295 b is real to be around 50 percent; a cosmic coin flip. For perspective, there's a dearth of discovered exoplanets around A-type stars.
paras.zh: 研究人员估计，候选系外行星 HD 156295 b 真实存在的可能性约为 50%；宇宙硬币翻转。从长远来看，在 A 型恒星周围发现的系外行星很少。

paras.en: You may need to take these results with a grain of salt, or add other proverbial seasonings, but in science false positives can be equally valuable for informing future searches.
paras.zh: 您可能需要对这些结果持保留态度，或者添加其他众所周知的调味品，但在科学中，误报对于为未来的搜索提供信息同样有价值。

paras.en: And, more specifically, constraining the occurrence of such intermediate-orbiting giant planets around whopping stars.
paras.zh: 更具体地说，限制这种围绕巨大恒星运行的中间轨道巨行星的出现。

paras.en: "The pulsation timing variations presented here are at the boundary of what should be detectable given the TESS data," the researchers note.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出：“这里提出的脉动时间变化处于 TESS 数据应可检测的范围内。”

paras.en: But more data are streaming in, and the European Space Agency's (ESA) PLATO observatory will soon offer improved precision in its mission to view over 200,000 stars.
paras.zh: 但越来越多的数据正在源源不断地涌入，欧洲航天局 (ESA) 的柏拉图天文台很快将在其观测超过 200,000 颗恒星的任务中提供更高的精度。

paras.en: A gas giant this size is an unlikely home for life, but who knows what freaky molecular magic might happen in a strange star's habitable zone.
paras.zh: 这种大小的气态巨行星不太可能成为生命的家园，但谁知道在一颗奇怪的恒星的宜居带中会发生什么奇怪的分子魔法。

paras.en: And at only 700 million years young, this system is just getting started.
paras.zh: 这个系统只有 7 亿年的历史，才刚刚起步。

paras.en: The research has been published in The Astrophysical Journal.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《天体物理学杂志》上。

articles.title: Popular Supplement Could Have an Unexpected Downside, Study Finds
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: Fish oil supplements have long been linked to a variety of brain benefits, but 2026 research suggests that one of the omega-3 fatty acids these supplements contain could interfere with the brain's repair processes.
paras.zh: 鱼油补充剂长期以来一直被认为对大脑有多种益处，但 2026 年的研究表明，这些补充剂中含有的一种 omega-3 脂肪酸可能会干扰大脑的修复过程。

paras.en: A study in mice affected by mild traumatic head injuries showed that animals fed diets containing the omega-3 fatty acid EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid) performed worse on spatial memory and learning tasks after the injuries.
paras.zh: 一项对遭受轻度头部创伤的小鼠进行的研究表明，喂食含有 omega-3 脂肪酸 EPA（二十碳五烯酸）的饮食的动物在受伤后的空间记忆和学习任务中表现较差。

paras.en: Rather than omega-3s aiding recovery as previous research has suggested, it seems EPA might actually get in the way of blood vessel repair, as it reprograms their metabolic activity.
paras.zh: 与先前研究表明的 omega-3 有助于恢复不同，EPA 似乎实际上可能会阻碍血管修复，因为它会重新编程血管的代谢活动。

paras.en: However, not all omega-3 fatty acids behave the same way.
paras.zh: 然而，并非所有 omega-3 脂肪酸的行为方式都相同。

paras.en: DHA (docosahexaenoic acid), an omega-3 fatty acid known to be important for building and maintaining brain cells, didn't interfere with repair processes in the researchers' follow-up experiments, which used human-derived brain microvascular endothelial cells – the cells that make up the blood-brain barrier.
paras.zh: DHA（二十二碳六烯酸）是一种 omega-3 脂肪酸，已知对构建和维持脑细胞很重要，在研究人员的后续实验中，它不会干扰修复过程，该实验使用了人源性大脑微血管内皮细胞（构成血脑屏障的细胞）。

paras.en: "Fish oil supplements are everywhere, and people take them for a range of reasons, often without a clear understanding of their long-term effects," says neuroscientist Onder Albayram, from Medical University of South Carolina (MUSC).
paras.zh: 南卡罗来纳医科大学 (MUSC) 的神经科学家 Onder Albayram 表示：“鱼油补充剂无处不在，人们服用它们的原因多种多样，但往往并不清楚它们的长期影响。”

paras.en: "But in terms of neuroscience, we still don't know whether the brain has resilience or resistance to this supplement. That's why ours is the first such study in the field."
paras.zh: “但就神经科学而言，我们仍然不知道大脑是否对这种补充剂有弹性或抵抗力。这就是为什么我们的研究是该领域的第一个此类研究。”

paras.en: The researchers call the observed effects a "context-dependent metabolic vulnerability", a shift in how cells use energy that potentially takes away some of the focus from brain repair under certain circumstances.
paras.zh: 研究人员将观察到的影响称为“环境依赖性代谢脆弱性”，即细胞使用能量方式的转变，在某些情况下可能会分散大脑修复的一些注意力。

paras.en: The harmful effects of EPA appeared only in injured mouse brains in repair mode, and it's unclear how those effects might play out in living human tissues.
paras.zh: EPA 的有害影响仅出现在处于修复模式的受损小鼠大脑中，目前尚不清楚这些影响如何在活体人体组织中发挥作用。

paras.en: One of the most significant findings from the study is that EPA, and not DHA, accumulated in the brains of mice fed these supplements. This fits with what we know about DHA being more readily built into brain cell membranes than EPA.
paras.zh: 该研究最重要的发现之一是，喂食这些补充剂的小鼠大脑中积聚的是 EPA，而不是 DHA。这符合我们所知道的 DHA 比 EPA 更容易嵌入脑细胞膜的事实。

paras.en: What's more, the researchers found that in mice, the destabilizing effects of EPA on blood vessels led to the build-up of toxic tau proteins linked to brain degeneration.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，研究人员发现，在小鼠中，EPA 对血管的不稳定作用导致了与大脑退化相关的有毒 tau 蛋白的积累。

paras.en: A further analysis of human brain tissue from individuals affected by chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), associated with repeated head injuries like those tested in the mice, showed a similar kind of metabolic disruption and blood vessel damage.
paras.zh: 对慢性创伤性脑病 (CTE) 患者的人类脑组织进行的进一步分析显示，慢性创伤性脑病 (CTE) 与重复的头部损伤有关，如在小鼠中进行的测试，结果显示出类似的代谢紊乱和血管损伤。

paras.en: The researchers speculate that fish oil supplements containing EPA may increase the risk of CTE if, by impairing cellular recovery, they exacerbate the effects of mild concussions that can easily go unchecked.
paras.zh: 研究人员推测，含有 EPA 的鱼油补充剂可能会增加 CTE 的风险，因为它们会损害细胞恢复，从而加剧很容易不受控制的轻度脑震荡的影响。

paras.en: But those ideas need further testing; the bulk of the evidence we're looking at here is from animal and cell experiments that only flag associations worth exploring further.
paras.zh: 但这些想法还需要进一步测试；我们在这里看到的大部分证据来自动物和细胞实验，这些实验只标记了值得进一步探索的关联。

paras.en: These ideas haven't come out of nowhere, though. While omega-3s are touted for their neuroprotective effects, some past research suggests EPA might be causing learning and memory impairments, which DHA helps balance out.
paras.zh: 不过，这些想法并非凭空而来。虽然 omega-3 因其神经保护作用而备受推崇，但过去的一些研究表明 EPA 可能会导致学习和记忆障碍，而 DHA 有助于平衡这种障碍。

paras.en: It's becoming clear that omega-3 fatty acids like EPA and DHA can be beneficial, but with caveats. There are no rules that apply equally to all brains.
paras.zh: 越来越明显的是，EPA 和 DHA 等 omega-3 脂肪酸可能是有益的，但也有一些注意事项。没有任何规则同样适用于所有大脑。

paras.en: "This idea of fish oil being a one-size-fits-all benefit doesn't work once you start investigating interactions," says neuroscientist Onur Eskiocak, from Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory.
paras.zh: 冷泉港实验室的神经科学家奥努尔·埃斯基奥卡克 (Onur Eskiocak) 表示：“一旦你开始研究相互作用，鱼油具有一刀切功效的想法就行不通了。”

paras.en: "But that doesn't mean it's bad for you."
paras.zh: “但这并不意味着这对你不好。”

paras.en: Related: Common Vitamin May Reduce Buildup of Alzheimer's Proteins, Study Finds
paras.zh: 相关：研究发现，常见维生素可以减少阿尔茨海默氏症蛋白质的积累

paras.en: The researchers are keen to expand their studies of EPA and DHA, looking at their effects on different types of brain cells and across a variety of brain regions, with clinical trials a potential option further down the line.
paras.zh: 研究人员热衷于扩大对 EPA 和 DHA 的研究，观察它们对不同类型脑细胞和不同大脑区域的影响，临床试验是进一步的潜在选择。

paras.en: "This paper is a starting point, but it is an important one," says Albayram.
paras.zh: “这篇论文是一个起点，但它是一个重要的起点，”阿尔拜拉姆说。

paras.en: "It opens a new conversation about precision nutrition in neuroscience, and it gives the field a framework to ask better, more testable questions."
paras.zh: “它开启了关于神经科学精准营养的新对话，并为该领域提供了一个提出更好、更可测试问题的框架。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Cell Reports.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《细胞报告》上。

articles.title: NASA’s Crew-13 could go from Florida to the ISS in under 9 hours

paras.en: NASAâs Crew-13 could go from Florida to the ISS in under 9 hours
paras.zh: NASA 的 Crew-13 可以在 9 小时内从佛罗里达州飞往国际空间站

paras.en: - NASA and SpaceX could launch four astronauts to the International Space Station on October 1, with the Dragon spacecraft reaching orbiting outpost less than nine hours after liftoff. Crew-13 will join Expedition 75 after teams complete a final round of intensive launch-readiness checks.
paras.zh: - NASA 和 SpaceX 可能于 10 月 1 日将四名宇航员发射到国际空间站，龙飞船在升空后不到 9 小时就到达轨道前哨站。在团队完成最后一轮密集的发射准备检查后，Crew-13 将加入 Expedition 75。

paras.en: NASA and SpaceX are targeting 11:10 a.m. EDT on Thursday, Oct. 1, as the earliest opportunity to launch the Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station.
paras.zh: NASA 和 SpaceX 的目标是美国东部时间 10 月 1 日星期四上午 11 点 10 分，这是向国际空间站发射 Crew-13 任务的最早机会。

paras.en: In the days before liftoff, teams will complete final preparations and readiness reviews to confirm that the astronauts, the space station, SpaceX's Dragon spacecraft, and the Falcon 9 rocket are ready for flight. The mission is scheduled to launch from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.
paras.zh: 在升空前的几天里，团队将完成最后的准备工作和准备情况审查，以确认宇航员、空间站、SpaceX 的龙飞船和猎鹰 9 号火箭已做好飞行准备。该任务计划从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站的 40 号航天发射场发射。

paras.en: Less Than Nine Hours to the Space Station
paras.zh: 不到九小时即可到达空间站

paras.en: If Crew-13 launches on Oct. 1, Dragon is expected to reach the International Space Station less than nine hours later, with docking planned for about 8 p.m. at the forward-facing port of the Harmony module.
paras.zh: 如果 Crew-13 于 10 月 1 日发射，“龙”号预计将在不到 9 小时后抵达国际空间站，计划于晚上 8 点左右对接。在 Harmony 模块的前向端口处。

paras.en: After launch, Falcon 9 will carry Dragon into orbit. The spacecraft will then maneuver to match the station's path before docking, a carefully controlled process in which Dragon lines up with a designated port and attaches securely.
paras.zh: 发射后，猎鹰9号将携带龙进入轨道。然后，航天器将在对接前进行机动以匹配空间站的路径，这是一个精心控制的过程，其中“龙”号与指定的端口对齐并牢固地连接。

paras.en: Harmony is one of the station's connecting modules and provides docking locations for visiting spacecraft.
paras.zh: 和谐号是空间站的连接模块之一，为来访的航天器提供停靠位置。

paras.en: NASA astronaut Jessica Watkins will serve as spacecraft commander, with NASA astronaut Luke Delaney as pilot. CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Joshua Kutryk and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov will serve as mission specialists.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局宇航员杰西卡·沃特金斯将担任航天器指挥官，美国宇航局宇航员卢克·德莱尼将担任飞行员。加拿大航天局（CSA）宇航员约书亚·库特里克（Joshua Kutryk）和俄罗斯航天局宇航员谢尔盖·捷捷亚特尼科夫（Sergey Teteryatnikov）将担任任务专家。

paras.en: After arriving at the station, the four astronauts will become members of Expedition 75. Space station expeditions are long duration missions during which crews conduct scientific research, maintain the orbiting laboratory, and support technology demonstrations and other operations.
paras.zh: 抵达空间站后，四名宇航员将成为第 75 号远征队的成员。空间站远征是一项长期任务，宇航员在此期间进行科学研究、维护轨道实验室并支持技术演示和其他操作。

paras.en: Crew-13 is currently in quarantine at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston, a standard preflight precaution designed to reduce the risk of illness before launch. The crew is scheduled to travel to NASA Kennedy on Saturday, Sept. 26, as final preparations continue for the planned Oct. 1 liftoff.
paras.zh: Crew-13 目前正在休斯顿 NASA 约翰逊航天中心接受隔离，这是标准的飞行前预防措施，旨在降低发射前患病的风险。机组人员定于 9 月 26 日星期六前往 NASA 肯尼迪号，为计划中的 10 月 1 日升空做最后的准备工作。

articles.title: Earth’s day isn’t exactly 24 hours. The reason may lie deep inside the planet

paras.en: Earthâs day isnât exactly 24 hours. The reason may lie deep inside the planet
paras.zh: 地球日并不是严格意义上的 24 小时。原因可能在于地球深处

paras.en: - Scientists may have solved why the length of Earthâs day changes by a few milliseconds over decades. Subtle shifts in the inner core appear to tug on the mantle, revealing a surprisingly dynamic world thousands of kilometers beneath our feet.
paras.zh: - 科学家可能已经解决了为什么地球一天的长度在几十年内会变化几毫秒。内核的微妙变化似乎在拉动地幔，揭示了我们脚下数千公里处令人惊讶的动态世界。

paras.en: Most of us think of a day as a fixed 24 hours. In reality, Earth's rotation is not perfectly constant.
paras.zh: 我们大多数人认为一天是固定的 24 小时。事实上，地球的自转并不是完全恒定的。

paras.en: The difference is tiny, measured in milliseconds, but physicists can detect it. Over time, some days become slightly shorter or longer depending on subtle changes deep inside the planet.
paras.zh: 差异很小，以毫秒为单位，但物理学家可以检测到它。随着时间的推移，根据地球深处的微妙变化，有些日子会变得稍微短一些或更长一些。

paras.en: For roughly three decades, scientists have known that Earth's liquid core does not always rotate at the same rate. Changes in the planet's magnetic field have revealed that the liquid core can gradually speed up over several decades, then slow down during the following decades.
paras.zh: 大约三十年来，科学家们已经知道地球的液体核心并不总是以相同的速度旋转。行星磁场的变化表明，液体核心可以在几十年内逐渐加速，然后在接下来的几十年内减速。

paras.en: At the same time, the mantle, the roughly 3,000 kilometer thick rocky layer that includes the crust, responds in the opposite direction. When the core speeds up, the mantle slows slightly. When the core slows, the mantle speeds up.
paras.zh: 与此同时，地幔（包括地壳在内的大约 3,000 公里厚的岩石层）也会向相反的方向做出反应。当地核加速时，地幔会稍微减慢。当地核减慢时，地幔就会加速。

paras.en: This exchange happens because Earth's total angular momentum must remain constant.
paras.zh: 这种交换的发生是因为地球的总角动量必须保持恒定。

paras.en: Even very small changes in the mantle's rotation are enough to alter the length of a day by a few milliseconds.
paras.zh: 即使地幔旋转的微小变化也足以使一天的长度改变几毫秒。

paras.en: Scientists have long struggled to explain exactly how the core and mantle exchange this rotational momentum.
paras.zh: 长期以来，科学家们一直在努力解释地核和地幔如何交换这种旋转动量。

paras.en: In a new study published Sept. 23 in Nature, University of Alberta physics PhD student Huifeng Zhang and professor Mathieu Dumberry present a possible answer.
paras.zh: 在 9 月 23 日《自然》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，阿尔伯塔大学物理学博士生张惠峰和马蒂厄·邓伯里教授提出了一个可能的答案。

paras.en: Their work shows that small changes in the rotational speed of Earth's inner core, the solid region at the planet's center, can create what scientists call a "gravitational torque." Because the inner core is not perfectly spherical, changes in its motion can gravitationally interact with uneven distributions of mass in the mantle.
paras.zh: 他们的工作表明，地球内核（地球中心的固体区域）旋转速度的微小变化可以产生科学家所说的“引力扭矩”。由于内核不是完美的球形，其运动的变化会与地幔中质量分布不均匀的重力相互作用。

paras.en: That interaction can slightly alter how quickly the mantle rotates, producing small changes in the length of a day.
paras.zh: 这种相互作用可以稍微改变地幔的旋转速度，从而使一天的长度产生微小的变化。

paras.en: Competing Forces Control Earth's Rotation
paras.zh: 竞争力控制地球自转

paras.en: Another force also acts at the boundary between the core and mantle.
paras.zh: 另一种力也作用于地核和地幔之间的边界。

paras.en: Known as core mantle boundary torque, it produces friction and electromagnetic drag that oppose the gravitational pull. This resistance helps limit how much Earth's day length can change.
paras.zh: 它被称为地核边界扭矩，它产生与引力相反的摩擦力和电磁阻力。这种阻力有助于限制地球白昼长度的变化程度。

paras.en: According to the researchers, the small observed variations in the length of a day arise from subtle shifts in the balance between gravitational torque and core mantle boundary torque.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，观察到的一天长度的微小变化是由于重力扭矩和地核边界扭矩之间的平衡的微妙变化造成的。

paras.en: Earth's Inner Core May Be More Dynamic Than Expected
paras.zh: 地球内核可能比预期更有活力

paras.en: Beyond helping explain a long standing mystery about Earth's changing day length, the findings also offer new insight into what is happening deep inside the planet.
paras.zh: 除了帮助解释地球日长变化的长期谜团之外，这些发现还为了解地球深处正在发生的事情提供了新的见解。

paras.en: Zhang and Dumberry say the inner core appears to "deform viscously" on a time scale of about 10 years, suggesting that Earth's deepest interior may change shape and respond to forces far more dynamically than its solid composition might imply.
paras.zh: 张和邓伯里说，内核似乎在大约10年的时间尺度上“粘性变形”，这表明地球最深处的形状可能会改变形状，并对力的反应比其固体成分所暗示的要动态得多。

paras.en: Materials provided by Nature. Original written by Geoff McMaster. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由《自然》提供。原著由杰夫·麦克马斯特撰写。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Huifeng Zhang, Mathieu Dumberry. Gravitational torque drives multidecadal variations in length of day. Nature, 2026; DOI: 10.1038/s41586-026-10999-2
paras.zh: - 张惠峰，马蒂厄·邓伯里。重力扭矩驱动了白昼长度的数十年变化。自然，2026； DOI：10.1038/s41586-026-10999-2

articles.title: The ice blasting from Saturn's moon Enceladus is stranger than scientists realized

paras.en: The ice blasting from Saturn's moon Enceladus is stranger than scientists realized
paras.zh: 土星卫星土卫二的冰喷发比科学家想象的更奇怪

paras.en: Enceladus may be naturally sorting and concentrating chemicals from its hidden ocean, potentially making the search for signs of life much easier.
paras.zh: 土卫二可能正在从其隐藏的海洋中自然地分类和浓缩化学物质，这可能使寻找生命迹象变得更加容易。

paras.en: - Enceladus may naturally separate and concentrate chemicals from its hidden ocean as droplets slowly freeze and shatter on their way into space. The process could explain Cassiniâs puzzling ice-grain chemistry while giving future spacecraft a powerful advantage in searching for organic compounds and clues to life.
paras.zh: - 当水滴在进入太空的过程中缓慢冻结和破碎时，土卫二可能会自然地从其隐藏的海洋中分离和浓缩化学物质。这一过程可以解释卡西尼号令人费解的冰粒化学，同时为未来的航天器在寻找有机化合物和生命线索方面提供强大的优势。

paras.en: Saturn's moon Enceladus is covered in ice, but beneath that frozen shell lies a global ocean. Near the moon's south pole, fractures in the crust release water vapor and ice particles into space. Those particles give scientists an unusual way to study an alien ocean without having to drill through kilometers of ice.
paras.zh: 土星的卫星土卫二被冰覆盖，但在冰冻的外壳下面却是一片全球海洋。在月球南极附近，地壳裂缝将水蒸气和冰粒释放到太空中。这些粒子为科学家提供了一种不寻常的方式来研究外星海洋，而无需钻穿数公里的冰层。

paras.en: An international team that includes researchers from the Earth-Life Science Institute (ELSI) at the Institute of Science Tokyo has now investigated what happens to that ocean water as it moves from beneath the surface and eventually becomes the tiny ice grains detected in space.
paras.zh: 一个由东京科学研究所地球生命科学研究所（ELSI）研究人员组成的国际团队现在正在研究海水从地表以下移动并最终变成在太空中检测到的微小冰粒时会发生什么。

paras.en: Cassini Found Surprisingly Diverse Ice Grains
paras.zh: 卡西尼号发现了令人惊讶的多样化冰粒

paras.en: Between 2004 and 2017, the Cosmic Dust Analyzer on NASA's Cassini spacecraft measured the composition of individual ice particles in Saturn's E-ring. That ring is continually supplied with material erupting from Enceladus.
paras.zh: 2004 年至 2017 年间，美国宇航局卡西尼号航天器上的宇宙尘埃分析仪测量了土星 E 环中单个冰粒的成分。土卫二喷发的物质源源不断地供给该环。

paras.en: A team led by Prof Frank Postberg at Freie Universität Berlin examined 961 mass spectra from salt-rich grains known as Type 3 particles. If the grains were simply small samples of the same ocean water, scientists might expect them to contain broadly similar mixtures of salts.
paras.zh: 柏林自由大学 Frank Postberg 教授领导的团队检查了来自被称为 3 型粒子的富含盐颗粒的 961 个质谱。如果这些颗粒只是同一海水的小样本，科学家可能会期望它们含有大致相似的盐混合物。

paras.en: Instead, the grains varied dramatically.
paras.zh: 相反，谷物的变化却很大。

paras.en: Some were especially rich in sodium chloride, while others contained higher amounts of carbonates, phosphates or potassium chloride. One particularly striking pattern was that chloride and carbonate rarely appeared together in the same sodium-rich particle.
paras.zh: 有些特别富含氯化钠，而另一些则含有较高含量的碳酸盐、磷酸盐或氯化钾。一种特别引人注目的模式是，氯化物和碳酸盐很少同时出现在同一个富含钠的颗粒中。

paras.en: That raised a basic puzzle. If all of these grains came from the same ocean, why did their chemical compositions differ so much?
paras.zh: 这就提出了一个基本的难题。如果所有这些谷物都来自同一个海洋，为什么它们的化学成分差异如此之大？

paras.en: Recreating Enceladus' Ocean Droplets in the Lab
paras.zh: 在实验室中重现土卫二的海洋水滴

paras.en: To explore that question, Professor Yasuhito Sekine and colleagues at ELSI created laboratory droplets containing the major salts thought to be present in Enceladus' ocean.
paras.zh: 为了探索这个问题，关根康仁教授和 ELSI 的同事创造了实验室液滴，其中含有被认为存在于土卫二海洋中的主要盐。

paras.en: The researchers froze droplets of different sizes under different cooling conditions, then studied how the chemical elements were distributed once the droplets had solidified.
paras.zh: 研究人员在不同的冷却条件下冷冻不同尺寸的液滴，然后研究液滴凝固后化学元素的分布情况。

paras.en: The results showed that the speed of freezing plays a major role.
paras.zh: 结果表明，冷冻速度起着重要作用。

paras.en: In droplets about 200 micrometres across, salts became separated into different regions when freezing occurred relatively slowly, at approximately 10 K per minute or less. When the droplets froze more quickly, their chemical ingredients remained much more evenly mixed.
paras.zh: 在直径约 200 微米的液滴中，当冻结速度相对较慢（大约每分钟 10 K 或更低）时，盐分会被分离到不同的区域。当液滴更快地冻结时，它们的化学成分混合得更加均匀。

paras.en: "What surprised us was that the diversity seen by Cassini could emerge from droplets originating from essentially the same ocean water," said Sekine. "Our experiments show that when relatively large ocean droplets freeze slowly, different salts can separate within them. If those frozen droplets are later broken apart, they can produce much smaller ice grains, each with very different chemical compositions."
paras.zh: “令我们惊讶的是，卡西尼号看到的多样性可能来自于本质上相同的海水的水滴，”关根说。 “我们的实验表明，当相对较大的海洋水滴缓慢冻结时，不同的盐会在其中分离。如果这些冻结的水滴随后分解，它们会产生更小的冰粒，每个冰粒的化学成分都非常不同。”

paras.en: The findings may also reveal something about what happens inside the moon's icy crust.
paras.zh: 这些发现还可能揭示月球冰壳内部发生的事情。

paras.en: Earlier studies generally assumed that seawater spray from Enceladus freezes quickly and moves rapidly toward space soon after leaving the ocean. The new experiments point to a different scenario.
paras.zh: 早期的研究普遍认为，来自土卫二的海水喷雾在离开海洋后很快就会冻结并迅速移向太空。新的实验指向了不同的场景。

paras.en: The droplets may initially move much more slowly through the underground vent system, following complicated pathways through fractures in the ice before they approach the surface.
paras.zh: 水滴最初通过地下通风系统的速度可能要慢得多，在到达地表之前，它们会沿着复杂的路径穿过冰的裂缝。

paras.en: The researchers suggest that ocean spray first forms droplets ranging from tens to hundreds of micrometers in size. As those droplets move slowly through deeper sections of the vents, they gradually freeze, giving salts enough time to separate into different regions.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，海洋喷雾首先形成尺寸从数十到数百微米不等的液滴。当这些水滴缓慢移动通过通风口的更深部分时，它们会逐渐冻结，从而使盐有足够的时间分离到不同的区域。

paras.en: Closer to the surface, conditions change. Gas begins moving faster, and the frozen droplets can slam into the walls of narrower icy channels at high speed. Those collisions may break the droplets into much smaller pieces.
paras.zh: 越靠近地表，情况就会发生变化。气体开始更快地移动，冻结的液滴可以高速撞击较窄的冰通道壁。这些碰撞可能会将液滴破碎成更小的碎片。

paras.en: Each fragment can come from a different salt-rich region within the original frozen droplet, creating grains with very different chemical compositions. Those fragments can then escape into space and become part of Saturn's E-ring.
paras.zh: 每个碎片都可能来自原始冷冻液滴内不同的富含盐的区域，从而产生具有非常不同的化学成分的颗粒。这些碎片随后可以逃逸到太空中，成为土星 E 环的一部分。

paras.en: "The Cassini data showed us that these salt-rich grains are far more chemically diverse than an average ocean composition would suggest," said Postberg. "Combining those observations with the freezing experiments gives us a physical explanation: Cassini may have sampled fragments of larger frozen ocean droplets, each preserving different components that became separated during their journey towards the surface. The abundance of each individual component in the ocean is then reflected in the number of fragments in which a particular component is found."
paras.zh: 波斯特伯格说：“卡西尼号的数据向我们表明，这些富含盐的颗粒的化学多样性比平均海洋成分所显示的要丰富得多。” “将这些观察结果与冷冻实验相结合，为我们提供了一个物理解释：卡西尼号可能采集了较大的冷冻海洋水滴的碎片，每个碎片都保存了在到达表面的过程中分离的不同成分。然后，海洋中每个单独成分的丰度反映在发现特定成分的碎片数量上。”

paras.en: Enceladus May Naturally Concentrate Key Compounds
paras.zh: 土卫二可能天然浓缩关键化合物

paras.en: The discovery could be especially important for future missions to Enceladus.
paras.zh: 这一发现对于未来的土卫二任务尤其重要。

paras.en: As droplets freeze and break apart, individual compounds can become concentrated in particular grains. The process does not only separate different salts. Earlier work has also shown that organic substances can become separated from one another and appear at elevated concentrations in certain particles.
paras.zh: 当液滴冻结并分解时，单个化合物会浓缩在特定的颗粒中。该过程不仅分离不同的盐。早期的研究还表明，有机物质可以相互分离，并以较高的浓度出现在某些颗粒中。

paras.en: That could make future analysis considerably easier.
paras.zh: 这可以使未来的分析变得更加容易。

paras.en: Compounds that are highly diluted in Enceladus' ocean and mixed with many other substances may become much easier to detect when concentrated into individual ice grains.
paras.zh: 在土卫二海洋中高度稀释并与许多其他物质混合的化合物在浓缩成单个冰粒时可能会变得更容易检测。

paras.en: On Earth, laboratories often spend considerable effort separating and concentrating chemicals before analyzing a sample. Enceladus appears to perform both of these "sample preparation" steps naturally: The chemical components become separated, and some end up concentrated within a fraction of the ice particles.
paras.zh: 在地球上，实验室在分析样品之前通常会花费大量精力来分离和浓缩化学物质。土卫二似乎自然地执行了这两个“样品制备”步骤：化学成分被分离，有些最终浓缩在一小部分冰粒中。

paras.en: Possible Implications for Prebiotic Chemistry
paras.zh: 对益生元化学的可能影响

paras.en: Slow freezing could have another important consequence.
paras.zh: 缓慢冷冻可能会产生另一个重要后果。

paras.en: As ice crystals grow, small pockets of liquid brine may remain trapped between them. Salts and organic compounds can become highly concentrated inside those pockets.
paras.zh: 随着冰晶的生长，冰晶之间可能会残留少量的液态盐水。盐和有机化合物会在这些口袋内高度浓缩。

paras.en: That concentration could matter for prebiotic chemistry, which involves chemical processes that may precede the emergence of life. One major challenge in such chemistry is bringing molecules that are normally very dilute into close contact with one another.
paras.zh: 这种浓度可能对生命起源前的化学很重要，该化学涉及可能在生命出现之前的化学过程。这种化学的一个主要挑战是使通常非常稀释的分子彼此紧密接触。

paras.en: Because much of the material erupted from Enceladus eventually falls back onto the moon, this freezing, concentration and recycling process could potentially happen again and again.
paras.zh: 由于土卫二喷发的大部分物质最终会落回月球，这种冻结、浓缩和回收过程可能会一次又一次地发生。

paras.en: Understanding how Enceladus forms its ice grains therefore does more than explain Cassini's unusual measurements. It offers new clues about the hidden environment beneath the moon's surface and may help future spacecraft correctly interpret the particles they collect while searching for evidence of habitability and possible signs of life.
paras.zh: 因此，了解土卫二如何形成冰粒不仅仅可以解释卡西尼号不寻常的测量结果。它提供了有关月球表面下隐藏环境的新线索，并可能帮助未来的航天器在寻找宜居性证据和可能的生命迹象时正确解释它们收集的粒子。

paras.zh: 材料由东京科学研究所提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Terran Orbital Names Jamin Brown Chief Operating Officer
articles.author: Terran Orbital

paras.en: IRVINE, Calif. – Sept. 29, 2026 – Terran Orbital, a Lockheed Martin company and a global leader in satellite-based solutions primarily serving the aerospace and defense industries, today announced the appointment of Jamin Brown as Chief Operating Officer (COO).
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州欧文 – 2026 年 9 月 29 日 – 洛克希德·马丁公司旗下公司、主要服务于航空航天和国防工业的卫星解决方案全球领导者 Terran Orbital 今天宣布任命 Jamin Brown 为首席运营官 (COO)。

paras.en: In this role, Brown will lead Terran Orbital’s operational execution, focusing on increasing production capacity, strengthening operational performance, and enabling the company to deliver at greater speed, scale, and cost efficiency. Based at Terran Orbital’s headquarters in Irvine, California, Brown will work closely with Peter Krauss, President and Chief Executive Officer, as the company prepares to meet growing customer demand.
paras.zh: 在此职位上，布朗将领导 Terran Orbital 的运营执行，重点关注提高产能、加强运营绩效，并使公司能够以更快的速度、更大的规模和更高的成本效率交付产品。布朗将驻扎在加利福尼亚州欧文市的 Terran Orbital 总部，与总裁兼首席执行官彼得·克劳斯 (Peter Krauss) 密切合作，帮助公司做好满足不断增长的客户需求的准备。

paras.en: “Terran Orbital is entering an important phase in our evolution, and our ability to scale while maintaining the agility, innovation, and mission focus that define us will be critical to our success,” said Krauss. “Jamin brings extensive experience leading complex technical organizations and executing some of the most demanding aerospace and defense programs. His operational leadership will help us strengthen execution, increase production, and ensure we are positioned to deliver for our customers as their needs continue to grow.”
paras.zh: 克劳斯说：“Terran Orbital 正在进入我们发展的一个重要阶段，我们在保持敏捷性、创新和任务重点的同时进行扩展的能力对于我们的成功至关重要。” “贾明带来了领导复杂技术组织和执行一些最苛刻的航空航天和国防项目的丰富经验。他的运营领导力将帮助我们加强执行力，增加产量，并确保我们能够随着客户需求的不断增长而为他们提供服务。”

paras.en: Brown joins Terran Orbital from Lockheed Martin Space, where he most recently served as Vice President of Missile Defense Programs and Huntsville Site General Manager. In that role, he led a diverse portfolio delivering integrated missile defense solutions for U.S. government and international military customers, including efforts involving Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD), Targets and Countermeasures Programs, directed energy, hypersonic defense, and space surveillance.
paras.zh: 布朗在加入人族轨道公司之前曾在洛克希德·马丁航天公司担任导弹防御项目副总裁和亨茨维尔基地总经理。在此职位上，他领导了多元化的产品组合，为美国政府和国际军事客户提供综合导弹防御解决方案，包括末段高空区域防御 (THAAD)、目标和对抗计划、定向能、高超音速防御和太空监视等方面的工作。

paras.en: Brown has more than two decades of experience at Lockheed Martin, beginning his career as an Electronics Engineer before progressing through positions of increasing responsibility across engineering, program management, and operations. His background includes P&L leadership roles, leadership in systems engineering, avionics development, and major program execution.
paras.zh: 布朗在洛克希德·马丁公司拥有二十多年的经验，他的职业生涯始于电子工程师，随后在工程、项目管理和运营等领域担任越来越重要的职务。他的背景包括损益领导角色、系统工程领导、航空电子设备开发和主要项目执行。

paras.en: He previously served as Deputy Vice President of the Hypersonic Strike Weapon Systems mission segment, where he helped lead rapid prototyping and fielding efforts for the Conventional Prompt Strike and Long-Range Hypersonic Weapon programs. Brown also served as Fleet Ballistic Missile Reshaping Site Director in Colorado, leading the transition of personnel and program operations from Sunnyvale, California, to Denver.
paras.zh: 他此前曾担任高超音速打击武器系统任务部分的副总裁，帮助领导常规快速打击和远程高超音速武器项目的快速原型设计和部署工作。布朗还担任科罗拉多州舰队弹道导弹改造基地主任，领导人员和项目运营从加利福尼亚州桑尼维尔到丹佛的过渡。

paras.en: “I’m excited to join Terran Orbital at such an important time for the company and our customers,” said Brown. “Terran Orbital has built a reputation for innovation, agility, and mission-focused execution. I look forward to working alongside Peter and the entire Terran Orbital team to build on that foundation, strengthen our operations and scale our capabilities to meet the growing needs of our customers.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴能在对公司和我们的客户来说如此重要的时刻加入 Terran Orbital，”布朗说。 “Terran Orbital 因创新、敏捷性和以任务为中心的执行力而享有盛誉。我期待着与 Peter 和整个 Terran Orbital 团队合作，在此基础上再接再厉，加强我们的运营并扩展我们的能力，以满足客户不断增长的需求。”

paras.en: Brown holds a Bachelor of Science in Electronics Engineering, a Master of Science in Industrial & Systems Engineering, and an MBA from San Jose State University. He is also a graduate of Stanford University’s Certified Program Manager program.
paras.zh: Brown 拥有圣何塞州立大学电子工程理学学士学位、工业与系统工程理学硕士学位以及 MBA 学位。他还是斯坦福大学认证项目经理项目的毕业生。

paras.en: Terran Orbital is a leading manufacturer of satellite solutions, providing end-to-end mission services for commercial, civil, and government customers. Terran Orbital specializes in designing, manufacturing, and operating advanced small satellites that support Earth observation, national security, and deep-space exploration missions. Terran Orbital is a wholly owned subsidiary of Lockheed Martin.
paras.zh: Terran Orbital 是领先的卫星解决方案制造商，为商业、民用和政府客户提供端到端任务服务。 Terran Orbital 专门从事设计、制造和运营支持地球观测、国家安全和深空探索任务的先进小型卫星。 Terran Orbital 是洛克希德·马丁公司的全资子公司。

articles.title: Commercial Defense Satcom Service Revenues to Surpass $22.6B by 2035
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | September 2026 — Novaspace’s Satellite Communications for Defense and Security, 2nd Edition highlights a defense Satcom market poised for rapid growth. By 2035, commercial satellite service revenues are projected to exceed $22.6 billion, while global defense Satcom demand is forecast to surpass 7.5 Tbps, driven by the adoption of next-generation non-geostationary orbit (NGSO) constellations.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 9 月——Novaspace 的国防和安全卫星通信第二版强调了国防卫星通信市场即将快速增长。到 2035 年，商业卫星服务收入预计将超过 226 亿美元，而在下一代非对地静止轨道 (NGSO) 星座采用的推动下，全球国防卫星通信需求预计将超过 7.5 Tbps。

paras.en: As defense organizations prioritize mobility, situational awareness, and network resilience, satellite communications are becoming a core element of modern military architectures, driving investment in secure, resilient connectivity for mission-critical operations.
paras.zh: 随着国防组织优先考虑移动性、态势感知和网络弹性，卫星通信正在成为现代军事架构的核心要素，推动对关键任务行动的安全、弹性连接的投资。

paras.en: “The growing adoption of distributed satcom architectures is rapidly enhancing military satcom resilience against disruption, jamming, and kinetic attacks,” notes Santiago Perez, Senior Manager at Novaspace. “As defense users increasingly adopt multi-orbit connectivity strategies, NGSO constellations will play a pivotal role in delivering the capacity, low latency, and resilience required for future military operations.”
paras.zh: Novaspace 高级经理圣地亚哥·佩雷斯 (Santiago Perez) 表示：“分布式卫星通信架构的日益普及正在迅速增强军用卫星通信抵御干扰、干扰和动能攻击的能力。” “随着国防用户越来越多地采用多轨道连接策略，NGSO 星座将在提供未来军事行动所需的容量、低延迟和弹性方面发挥关键作用。”

paras.en: NGSO service revenues are expected to reach $21.3 billion by 2035, supported by a 34% CAGR. Although GEO revenues will decline from $2.3 billion in 2025 to $1.3 billion in 2035, GEO capacity demand is forecast to triple, underscoring its strategic importance within hybrid, multi-orbit networks.
paras.zh: NGSO 服务收入预计到 2035 年将达到 213 亿美元，复合年增长率为 34%。尽管 GEO 收入将从 2025 年的 23 亿美元下降到 2035 年的 13 亿美元，但 GEO 容量需求预计将增加两倍，凸显其在混合多轨道网络中的战略重要性。

paras.en: The United States is expected to remain the largest defense Satcom market through 2035, accounting for more than 50% of global demand and 48% of revenues. China is projected to follow with around 30% of global demand and revenues, reinforcing the central role of satellite communications in the military modernization efforts of the world’s leading powers.
paras.zh: 预计到 2035 年，美国仍将是最大的国防卫星通信市场，占全球需求的 50% 以上和收入的 48% 以上。预计中国将占据全球约 30% 的需求和收入，从而加强卫星通信在世界主要大国军事现代化努力中的核心作用。

paras.en: “What we’re witnessing is not simply a shift in satellite capacity demand. This is a fundamental evolution in military communications,” adds Perez. “Multi-orbit connectivity is becoming the foundation of modern defense networks and will shape procurement, operations, and strategic planning for years to come.”
paras.zh: “我们看到的不仅仅是卫星容量需求的变化。这是军事通信的根本性演变，”佩雷斯补充道。 “多轨道连接正在成为现代国防网络的基础，并将影响未来几年的采购、运营和战略规划。”

paras.en: Novaspace’s Satellite Communications for Defense and Security, 2nd Edition delivers a comprehensive analysis of the military Satcom market, examining key industry trends and the evolving balance between supply and demand for broadband satellite communications. The report provides detailed qualitative and quantitative insights by region, military force, orbit, and frequency band, alongside profiles of the leading commercial satellite systems supporting defense and security operations.
paras.zh: Novaspace 的国防和安全卫星通信第二版对军用卫星通信市场进行了全面分析，研究了关键行业趋势以及宽带卫星通信供需之间不断变化的平衡。该报告提供了按地区、军事力量、轨道和频段详细的定性和定量见解，以及支持国防和安全行动的领先商业卫星系统的概况。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球范围内开展业务，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。

articles.title: Quantum Space Executes Launch Processing Agreement with All Points Logistics for Prime Mission
articles.author: Quantum Space

paras.en: ROCKVILLE, Md. and MERRITT ISLAND, Fla. — September 30, 2026 — Quantum Space, LLC (the “Company” or “Quantum Space”), a company developing the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security and commercial missions, today announced that it has executed a new spacecraft processing work order with All Points Logistics, LLC (“All Points”) for the launch campaign for Quantum Space’s Prime mission.
paras.zh: 马里兰州罗克维尔和佛罗里达州梅里特岛 - 2026 年 9 月 30 日 - Quantum Space, LLC（“公司”或“Quantum Space”）是一家为国家安全和商业任务开发下一代先进机动航天器的公司，今天宣布它已与 All Points Logistics, LLC（“All Points”）执行了一项新的航天器处理工作订单，用于 Quantum Space 的 Prime 任务的发射活动。

paras.en: Prime is a pathfinder mission for the Company’s Ranger and Scout platform and will help the Company evaluate spacecraft performance, payload hosting, and data collection. Quantum Space has completed a Systems Integration Review for the mission and is targeting the second half of 2027 for launch. Under the agreement, All Points will provide specialized spacecraft processing services in preparation for the launch, including clean-room facilities, propellant servicing support, launch-site safety and operational reviews, ground support activities, and transportation to the launch vehicle integration facility. The work is scheduled to support Prime launch preparations in 2027.
paras.zh: Prime 是该公司 Ranger 和 Scout 平台的探路者任务，将帮助该公司评估航天器性能、有效载荷托管和数据收集。 Quantum Space 已完成该任务的系统集成审查，并计划于 2027 年下半年发射。根据协议，All Points 将提供专门的航天器处理服务，为发射做准备，包括洁净室设施、推进剂服务支持、发射场安全和操作审查、地面支持活动以及运载火箭集成设施的运输。这项工作计划支持 2027 年 Prime 的推出准备工作。

paras.en: “This agreement comes as Prime moves into the detailed planning and execution stage required to successfully conduct a launch campaign,” said Kerry Wisnosky, President of Quantum Space. “Many activities must come together between completing a spacecraft and getting it safely integrated onto a launch vehicle, and All Points brings the specialized infrastructure, people and launch-site experience required to help us execute that process.”
paras.zh: Quantum Space 总裁 Kerry Wisnosky 表示：“这项协议的签署正值 Prime 进入成功开展发射活动所需的详细规划和执行阶段。” “在完成航天器和将其安全地集成到运载火箭上之间必须进行许多活动，而 All Points 提供了帮助我们执行该过程所需的专业基础设施、人员和发射场经验。”

paras.en: The new work order builds upon an existing Master Services Agreement between the two companies. It establishes a specific scope of work for the Prime mission, focused on ground processing and launch-site activities required for Prime at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, representing another concrete step toward launch.
paras.zh: 新的工作订单建立在两家公司之间现有的主服务协议的基础上。它为 Prime 任务确定了具体的工作范围，重点关注 Prime 任务在加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地所需的地面处理和发射场活动，这代表着发射又迈出了具体的一步。

paras.en: “Supporting Prime is exactly the type of mission where All Points’ launch infrastructure and spacecraft processing capabilities can make a difference,” said Phil Monkress, President and CEO of All Points Logistics. “We are pleased to expand our relationship with Quantum Space and support their team as Ranger Prime advances toward launch.”
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Monkress 表示：“支持 Prime 正是 All Points 的发射基础设施和航天器处理能力可以发挥作用的任务类型。” “我们很高兴扩大与 Quantum Space 的关系，并在 Ranger Prime 即将发射之际为他们的团队提供支持。”

paras.en: Prime will be the first of Quantum Space’s high-performance class spacecraft, being developed to provide customers with significant maneuverability, long-duration operations and the ability to host and support a broad range of national security and commercial missions.
paras.zh: Prime 将成为 Quantum Space 高性能级航天器中的第一艘，其开发目的是为客户提供显着的机动性、长期运行以及托管和支持广泛的国家安全和商业任务的能力。

paras.en: “Securing our launch-site processing capability is another important element of mitigating execution risk as we move Prime toward flight,” Wisnosky added. “Our focus now is on completing the spacecraft, executing the environmental test campaign and moving through launch integration and ultimately to on-orbit operations.”
paras.zh: Wisnosky 补充道：“在我们将 Prime 推向飞行的过程中，确保我们的发射场处理能力是降低执行风险的另一个重要因素。” “我们现在的重点是完成航天器、执行环境测试活动并进行发射集成并最终进入在轨运行。”

paras.en: Quantum Space is building the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security, civil, and commercial space operations. Its highly maneuverable spacecraft are being designed to address the needs of national security and commercial operators. With patented propulsion, extended on-orbit endurance, and modular flexibility, these platforms are being engineered to outmaneuver legacy satellites and operate dynamically across diverse mission sets. For more information, visit www.quantumspaceinc.com.
paras.zh: 量子空间公司正在为国家安全、民用和商业太空运营建造下一代先进的可操纵航天器。其高度机动的航天器旨在满足国家安全和商业运营商的需求。凭借获得专利的推进力、延长的在轨续航力和模块化灵活性，这些平台的设计目的是超越传统卫星，并在不同的任务集中动态运行。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.quantumspaceinc.com。

paras.en: Established in 1997 as a service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), All Points Logistics has operations in multiple states and has grown into a leading solution provider to a diverse array of government and commercial customers, with award-winning expertise in software development, IT services, modeling and simulation, launch support services, and integrated logistics. Learn more at allpointsllc.com.
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 成立于 1997 年，是一家退伍军人拥有的小型企业 (SDVOSB)，在多个州开展业务，现已发展成为面向各类政府和商业客户的领先解决方案提供商，在软件开发、IT 服务、建模和模拟、启动支持服务和综合物流方面拥有屡​​获殊荣的专业知识。如需了解更多信息，请访问 allpointsllc.com。

After the Registration Statement is declared effective, Inflection Point will mail a definitive proxy statement and other relevant documents to its shareholders as of the record date established for voting on the Business Combination. This communication is not a substitute for the Registration Statement, the definitive proxy statement/prospectus or any other document that Inflection Point will send to its shareholders in connection with the Business Combination.
paras.zh: 业务合并将提交给 Inflection Point 股东审议。就业务合并而言，IPFX Pubco, Inc.、Inflection Point 和 Quantum Space 打算向 SEC 提交一份登记声明，其中将包括一份委托书/招股说明书和某些其他相关文件，这些文件将作为分发给 Inflection Point 股东的委托书，以征求其股东就业务合并和注册声明中描述的其他事项进行投票的委托书，以及与该业务合并相关的招股说明书。为完成业务合并而向 Inflection Point 的证券持有人和 Quantum Space 的股东发行和出售证券。注册声明宣布生效后，Inflection Point 将自企业合并投票登记日起向股东邮寄最终委托书和其他相关文件。本通讯不能替代注册声明、最终委托书/招股说明书或 Inflection Point 将向其股东发送的与业务合并相关的任何其他文件。

paras.en: INVESTORS AND SECURITY HOLDERS ARE ADVISED TO READ, WHEN AVAILABLE, THE REGISTRATION STATEMENT, PROXY STATEMENT/PROSPECTUS AND ANY OTHER RELEVANT DOCUMENTS FILED WITH THE SEC CAREFULLY AND IN THEIR ENTIRETY IF AND WHEN THEY BECOME AVAILABLE BECAUSE THEY WILL CONTAIN IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT THE BUSINESS COMBINATION AND THE PARTIES TO THE BUSINESS COMBINATION.
paras.zh: 建议投资者和证券持有人仔细阅读向 SEC 提交的注册声明、代理声明/招股说明书以及任何其他向 SEC 提交的相关文件（如有），因为它们将包含有关该业务的重要信息合并及业务合并各方。

The definitive proxy statement/prospectus (when available) will be mailed to shareholders of Inflection Point as of a record date to be established for voting on the Business Combination. Shareholders of Inflection Point will also be able to obtain copies of the definitive proxy statement/prospectus without charge, once available, by directing a request to: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VI, 1680 Michigan Avenue, Suite 700 #1031, Miami Beach, FL 33139.
paras.zh: 投资者和证券持有人将能够在 www.sec.gov 上免费获取这些文件的副本（如果有）以及向 SEC 提交的其他文件。最终的委托书/招股说明书（如有）将在企业合并投票记录日起邮寄给 Inflection Point 的股东。 Inflection Point 的股东还可以免费获取最终委托书/招股说明书的副本（一旦可用），只需将请求发送至：Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VI, 1680 Michigan Avenue, Suite 700 #1031, Miami Beach, FL 33139。

Additional information regarding the interests of participants in the proxy solicitation and their direct and indirect interests will be contained in the Registration Statement and the proxy statement/prospectus when they become available.
