articles.title: World News in Brief: Deadly Myanmar strikes as Malaysia begins deportations, new emergency funding released, Gaza and West Bank update

paras.en: World News in Brief: Deadly Myanmar strikes as Malaysia begins deportations, new emergency funding released, Gaza and West Bank update
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：马来西亚开始驱逐、新的紧急资金发放、加沙和约旦河西岸最新情况，缅甸发生致命袭击

paras.en: The UN chief on Tuesday strongly condemned an airstrike that reportedly killed at least 50 people at a market in Myanmar’s Rakhine state and called for those responsible to be held to account.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长周二强烈谴责据报道在缅甸若开邦一个市场造成至少 50 人死亡的空袭，并呼吁追究责任人的责任。

paras.en: Forces from the military junta reportedly hit Kyauktaw township around midday on Monday, when the market’s more than 200 shops were busy with vendors, customers and transport workers
paras.zh: 据报道，军政府部队于周一中午左右袭击了皎都镇，当时市场上的 200 多家商店挤满了摊贩、顾客和运输工人

paras.en: Women and children were among the dead and at least 58 people were injured, many critically. The toll is expected to rise.
paras.zh: 死者中有妇女和儿童，至少有 58 人受伤，其中许多人伤势严重。预计死亡人数还会上升。

paras.en: UN human rights chief Volker Türk said the attack raised serious concerns about respect for international humanitarian law, describing Myanmar as a country “wracked by extreme violence”.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克表示，这次袭击引发了人们对国际人道主义法尊重的严重担忧，并称缅甸是一个“遭受极端暴力蹂躏”的国家。

paras.en: He highlighted abuses against the Rohingya in particular by both the army and the opposition Arakan Army armed group.
paras.zh: 他强调了军队和反对派若开军武装团体对罗兴亚人的虐待行为。

paras.en: The strike came hours before Malaysia began implementing a plan to deport some 5,000 Myanmar nationals.
paras.zh: 这次罢工发生在马来西亚开始实施驱逐约 5,000 名缅甸国民的计划几个小时前。

paras.en: The plan follows a reported agreement between Myanmar’s military rulers and Kuala Lumpur, which Malaysia has said would involve only voluntary repatriations.
paras.zh: 据报道，该计划是在缅甸军事统治者与吉隆坡达成一项协议之后制定的，马来西亚表示该协议仅涉及自愿遣返。

paras.en: The UN refugee agency, UNHCR, says it has not been involved in identifying those being returned, who have reportedly been held in detention centres.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署表示，它没有参与确认被遣返者的身份，据报道，这些人被关押在拘留中心。

paras.en: Mr. Türk urged the authorities to halt the process immediately, warning that conditions in Myanmar are “far from safe and sustainable”.
paras.zh: 图尔克敦促当局立即停止这一进程，并警告说缅甸的状况“远非安全和可持续”。

paras.en: The UN chief echoed that call over the reported return of some 1,500 people, with UNHCR stressing that no one should be sent back to a place where they risk persecution or torture, and that continuing violence in Rakhine shows conditions do not exist for safe, voluntary returns.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长回应了据报道约 1,500 人返回的呼吁，联合国难民署强调，任何人都不应该被送回可能遭受迫害或酷刑的地方，而若开邦持续的暴力表明不存在安全、自愿返回的条件。

paras.en: Fletcher unlocks funds ahead of El Niño-driven drought in Africa
paras.zh: 弗莱彻在厄尔尼诺现象导致非洲干旱之前释放资金

paras.en: UN relief chief Tom Fletcher has released millions of dollars from the Central Emergency Response Fund (CERF) to get ahead of the worst impacts of El Niño-driven drought in South Sudan, Zimbabwe and Chad.
paras.zh: 联合国救援负责人汤姆·弗莱彻已从中央应急基金（CERF）拨款数百万美元，以应对厄尔尼诺现象引发的干旱对南苏丹、津巴布韦和乍得造成的最严重影响。

paras.en: In South Sudan, where more than two in every three people – over 10 million in total – already need aid, $6 million will support early action on a worsening drought that Mr. Fletcher warned is putting lives and livelihoods at risk.
paras.zh: 在南苏丹，每三个人中就有超过两个人（总共超过 1000 万人）需要援助，600 万美元将用于支持针对日益严重的干旱采取早期行动，弗莱彻先生警告说，干旱正在危及生命和生计。

paras.en: The funds will help provide food, health, nutrition, protection, water and sanitation services.
paras.zh: 这些资金将帮助提供食品、健康、营养、保护、水和卫生服务。

paras.en: In Zimbabwe, $4 million will be used for anticipatory action to get food, health and nutrition support in place before the drought arrives.
paras.zh: 在津巴布韦，400万美元将用于预防性行动，以便在干旱到来之前提供粮食、健康和营养支持。

paras.en: In Chad, $3.6 million will help 350,000 people prepare for dry conditions that could worsen food insecurity and undermine livelihoods.
paras.zh: 在乍得，360万美元将帮助35万人应对可能加剧粮食不安全和生计的干旱天气。

paras.en: The funds were released automatically once trigger thresholds were met, bringing anticipatory action funding for the drought in seven different regions of Chad to $8 million since the start of the year.
paras.zh: 一旦达到触发阈值，这些资金就会自动释放，使年初以来乍得七个不同地区的干旱预期行动资金达到 800 万美元。

paras.en: The funds will complement the Chadian government’s efforts and support early warning, cash assistance for vulnerable households, livestock feed, malnutrition screening and treatment, disease surveillance and the prevention and treatment of gender-based violence.
paras.zh: 这些资金将补充乍得政府的努力，并支持早期预警、对弱势家庭的现金援助、牲畜饲料、营养不良筛查和治疗、疾病监测以及性别暴力的预防和治疗。

paras.en: The UN has set up a Global Emergency Fund to help people in crises around the world. You can donate here.
paras.zh: 联合国设立了全球紧急基金来帮助世界各地陷入危机的人们。您可以在这里捐款。

paras.en: Israeli fire near UN sites in Gaza as settler attacks continue in West Bank
paras.zh: 以色列在加沙联合国驻地附近开火，定居者继续袭击西岸

paras.en: Israeli fire was reported near UN facilities and humanitarian convoys in Gaza on several occasions in recent days, according to the UN humanitarian office (OCHA) on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 据联合国人道主义办公室（OCHA）周二称，最近几天，以色列在加沙的联合国设施和人道主义车队附近多次发生火灾。

paras.en: No casualties have been reported, but the UN stressed that civilians – including aid workers and humanitarian operations – must always be protected.
paras.zh: 目前尚无人员伤亡的报道，但联合国强调，包括援助人员和人道主义行动在内的平民必须始终受到保护。

paras.en: Aid work continues. In the third week of September, protection partners gave around 13,000 Gazans mental health support, counselling and other services.
paras.zh: 援助工作仍在继续。 9 月第三周，保护合作伙伴为约 13,000 名加沙人提供了心理健康支持、咨询和其他服务。

paras.en: They also distributed around 740 food parcels, 6,000 adult diapers and 2,000 assistive devices including wheelchairs, as well as hygiene kits for more than 200 displaced families.
paras.zh: 他们还为 200 多个流离失所家庭分发了约 740 个食品包、6,000 个成人尿布和 2,000 个辅助设备（包括轮椅）以及卫生用品包。

paras.en: The UN agency for Palestine refugees, UNRWA, says 1,394 Palestinians have been killed since the faltering October 2025 ceasefire, citing local health authorities, and that some 94 per cent of the population need shelter assistance.
paras.zh: 联合国巴勒斯坦难民机构近东救济工程处援引当地卫生当局的话说，自 2025 年 10 月停火协议摇摇欲坠以来，已有 1,394 名巴勒斯坦人被杀，约 94% 的人口需要住房援助。

paras.en: Settler attacks continue to undermine Palestinians’ safety and livelihoods, OCHA says, adding to pressure on people to leave their homes. Several houses were damaged in the village of Jalud, in Nablus governorate, on Monday night.
paras.zh: 人道协调厅表示，定居者的袭击继续损害巴勒斯坦人的安全和生计，加大了人们离开家园的压力。周一晚上，纳布卢斯省贾鲁德村的几栋房屋遭到破坏。

paras.en: Over the weekend in Tubas governorate, a water network serving Palestinians was vandalised and vehicles carrying water and produce were seized.
paras.zh: 周末，在图巴斯省，为巴勒斯坦人提供服务的供水网络遭到破坏，运水和农产品的车辆被扣押。

paras.en: News reports said more than 100 settlers attacked Jalud, stopping the al-Tubasi family from returning to homes that settlers had seized weeks earlier.
paras.zh: 新闻报道称，100 多名定居者袭击了 Jalud，阻止 al-Tubasi 一家返回定居者几周前占领的房屋。

paras.en: The family was reportedly escorted by Israeli forces after Israel’s High Court ruled earlier this month that they must be allowed back.
paras.zh: 据报道，在以色列高等法院本月早些时候裁定必须允许他们返回后，这家人被以色列军队护送。

paras.en: Two of their houses were set on fire and Israeli security forces were also targeted, according to news reports.
paras.zh: 据新闻报道，他们的两栋房屋被纵火，以色列安全部队也成为目标。

paras.en: OCHA has recorded more than 1,600 settler attacks this year – an average of 6.7 a day, up from five a day in 2025 – and more than 4,300 Palestinians have been displaced.
paras.zh: 人道协调厅今年记录了超过 1,600 起定居者袭击事件——平均每天 6.7 起，而 2025 年为每天 5 起——超过 4,300 名巴勒斯坦人流离失所。

articles.title: Lebanon: one in five children goes to bed hungry, says UNICEF

paras.en: Lebanon: one in five children goes to bed hungry, says UNICEF
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会称，黎巴嫩：五分之一的儿童饿着肚子睡觉

paras.en: Four in five households in Lebanon struggle to afford basic necessities today, with children increasingly going without food, missing school and being pushed into work as conflict compounds years of economic crisis. "I wanted to buy clothes for my children, but I could not. I also wanted to enrol them in school, but I could not afford that either," said one father of four, cited on Wednesday by the UN Children's Fund (UNICEF).
paras.zh: 如今，黎巴嫩五分之四的家庭难以负担基本生活必需品，由于冲突加剧了多年的经济危机，儿童越来越缺乏食物、缺课并被迫工作。联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）周三援引一位四个孩子的父亲的话说：“我想给孩子们买衣服，但我买不到。我还想让他们上学，但我也买不起。”

paras.en: In an alert on Wednesday, UNICEF said that children go to bed hungry in at least one in five households. A similar number of families do not have enough drinking water either.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会在周三的一份警报中表示，至少五分之一的家庭中，孩子们饿着肚子上床睡觉。类似数量的家庭也没有足够的饮用水。

paras.en: “Children and young people in Lebanon are being asked to bear a burden no child should have to carry,” said UNICEF Lebanon Representative Marcoluigi Corsi, highlighting the “profound psychological distress” impacting an estimated 770,000 youngsters.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会驻黎巴嫩代表马可路易吉·科西 (Marcoluigi Corsi) 表示：“黎巴嫩的儿童和青少年被要求承担不该由儿童承担的负担。”他强调，估计有 77 万名青少年面临着“严重的心理困扰”。

paras.en: “Without urgent and sustained action, these pressures are shaping their lives for years to come,” he stressed.
paras.zh: 他强调说：“如果不采取紧急和持续的行动，这些压力将在未来几年影响他们的生活。”

paras.en: It is nearly six months since a 17 April ceasefire agreement between Lebanon and Israel seeking to end hostilities between Lebanon-based Hezbollah fighters and the Israeli military, linked to the U.S.-Iran war. Airstrikes and demolitions of homes continue, UNICEF noted.
paras.zh: 自 4 月 17 日黎巴嫩和以色列达成停火协议以来已近六个月，该协议旨在结束黎巴嫩真主党战士与以色列军队之间与美伊战争有关的敌对行动。联合国儿童基金会指出，空袭和拆除房屋仍在继续。

paras.en: Of the more than one million people displaced within weeks of the escalation, nearly 330,000 have yet to go home, because of continued attacks and widespread destruction in southern Lebanon, "where Israel still occupies a strip of land".
paras.zh: 升级后几周内，超过一百万人流离失所，其中近 33 万人尚未回家，因为黎巴嫩南部的持续袭击和大范围破坏，“以色列仍然占领着那里的一小片土地”。

paras.en: In its latest update, the UN aid coordination office, OCHA, also reported continuing “air strikes, shelling, demolitions and military activity” across south Lebanon, with restricted humanitarian access and unviable conditions for safe and sustainable returns.
paras.zh: 联合国援助协调办公室人道协调厅在最新更新中还报告称，黎巴嫩南部地区持续发生“空袭、炮击、拆除和军事活动”，人道主义援助准入受到限制，安全和可持续回返的条件不具备。

paras.en: According to UNICEF’s latest report, An Enduring Nightmare, around one in three families surveyed said that their children had missed necessary healthcare, mainly because they could not afford it.
paras.zh: 根据联合国儿童基金会的最新报告《持久的噩梦》，大约三分之一的受访家庭表示，他们的孩子错过了必要的医疗保健，主要是因为他们负担不起。

paras.en: Fourteen per cent said at least one child was working, more than twice the proportion recorded in January 2025.
paras.zh: 14% 的人表示至少有一名儿童在工作，是 2025 年 1 月记录比例的两倍多。

paras.en: The conflict has also exacted a devastating human toll. Since 2 March 2026, at least 261 children have been killed and 1,056 injured, an average of seven children killed or injured every day over six months. An estimated 12 per cent of injured children now live with a disability, highlighting the conflict's long-term consequences on them.
paras.zh: 冲突还造成了毁灭性的人员伤亡。自 2026 年 3 月 2 日以来，至少有 261 名儿童死亡、1,056 名儿童受伤，六个月内平均每天有 7 名儿童死亡或受伤。据估计，目前有 12% 的受伤儿童患有残疾，这突显了冲突对他们造成的长期后果。

paras.en: Education has been severely disrupted, UNICEF noted, with 436 schools damaged or destroyed, putting around 100,000 children at risk of losing access to a classroom. A further 86 teachers have been killed or injured.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会指出，教育受到严重干扰，436 所学校遭到损坏或毁坏，约 10 万名儿童面临无法上学的风险。另有 86 名教师遇难或受伤。

paras.en: I need mental health support and safe spaces where I can talk openly about my concerns and get the support I need - Young woman's story from UNICEF report
paras.zh: 我需要心理健康支持和安全空间，在那里我可以公开谈论我的担忧并获得我需要的支持——联合国儿童基金会报告中年轻女性的故事

paras.en: Financial pressures are also forcing families to cut education spending, with 46 per cent reporting reduced expenditure and 17 per cent saying their children had stopped attending school. Among those still in education, 29 per cent were unable to learn as expected, often because of difficulties concentrating and emotional distress.
paras.zh: 财务压力也迫使家庭削减教育支出，46%的家庭表示支出减少，17%的家庭表示他们的孩子已经停止上学。在仍在接受教育的人中，29% 的人无法按预期学习，通常是因为难以集中注意力和情绪困扰。

paras.en: The psychological impact of the crisis is equally alarming. An estimated 770,000 children have experienced psychological distress over the past six months. More than half of households reported a deterioration in their children's emotional well-being, while 63 per cent said their children were anxious or nervous.
paras.zh: 危机的心理影响同样令人震惊。过去六个月里，估计有 770,000 名儿童经历了心理困扰。超过一半的家庭表示孩子的情绪健康状况恶化，而 63% 的家庭表示孩子感到焦虑或紧张。

paras.en: Young people are also facing diminishing prospects. An earlier UNICEF assessment this year found that only 22 per cent of those aged 18 to 25 were attending school or university, largely because of financial barriers. At the time of the survey, 67 per cent were unemployed.
paras.zh: 年轻人也面临着前景黯淡的情况。联合国儿童基金会今年早些时候的一项评估发现，18 岁至 25 岁的人中只有 22% 正在上学或上大学，这主要是由于经济障碍。调查时，67%的人处于失业状态。

paras.en: We fled the southern suburbs (of Beirut). The sounds affected my son so much that when I brought him a beautiful, colourful toy that makes sounds, he became afraid of it and cried a lot - Mother of seven-month-old baby in UNICEF report
paras.zh: 我们逃离了（贝鲁特）南郊。这些声音对我儿子的影响如此之大，以至于当我给他带来一个漂亮、色彩缤纷、会发出声音的玩具时，他变得害怕并哭得很厉害——联合国儿童基金会报告中七个月大婴儿的母亲

paras.en: UNICEF has stepped up its humanitarian response since January 2026, treating injured children, delivering supplies to shelters and medical facilities, and supporting displaced families. The agency is also working to sustain national systems and services for children.
paras.zh: 自 2026 年 1 月以来，联合国儿童基金会加强了人道主义应对行动，治疗受伤儿童，向避难所和医疗设施运送物资，并为流离失所的家庭提供支持。该机构还致力于维持国家儿童系统和服务。

paras.en: “Without urgent and sustained action, an entire generation of children and young people risks carrying the scars of this crisis into adulthood,” said Mr. Corsi.
paras.zh: 科西先生说：“如果不采取紧急和持续的行动，整整一代儿童和年轻人都有可能将这场危机的伤疤带入成年。”

paras.en: UNICEF stressed that the conflict has exacerbated the damage and suffering caused by the last period of fighting in 2023–2024 and the social and economic crisis that has persisted since late 2019. Today, 83 per cent of displaced families say they don't know when they'll be able to return home, underscoring the scale of the challenge of rebuilding.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会强调，这场冲突加剧了 2023-2024 年最后一段战斗造成的损害和痛苦，以及自 2019 年底以来持续存在的社会和经济危机。如今，83% 的流离失所家庭表示，他们不知道何时能够返回家园，这凸显了重建挑战的规模。

paras.en: “Lebanon’s recovery depends on protecting children now and upholding their right to health care, education, protection and the opportunities they need to build their futures,” the agency insisted.
paras.zh: 该机构坚称：“黎巴嫩的复苏取决于现在保护儿童并维护他们获得医疗保健、教育、保护和建设未来所需机会的权利。”

articles.title: Malaysia: UN agency urges safeguards after refugees returned to Myanmar

paras.en: Malaysia: UN agency urges safeguards after refugees returned to Myanmar
paras.zh: 马来西亚：联合国机构敦促难民返回缅甸后采取保障措施

paras.en: The UN refugee agency, UNHCHR, has voiced concern over Malaysia’s decision to return 1,476 people to Myanmar amid an ongoing civil war and a dire human rights and humanitarian situation.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署对马来西亚在持续内战以及严峻的人权和人道主义状况下决定将 1,476 人遣返回缅甸表示担忧。

paras.en: Deportation of Rohingya refugees began on Tuesday, according to reports.
paras.zh: 据报道，罗辛亚难民的驱逐行动于周二开始。

paras.en: “We are concerned by these returns at a time when people sent back to Myanmar may face serious risks, and some within the group may be in need of international protection,” said UNHCR Assistant High Commissioner for Protection Edem Wosornu.
paras.zh: 难民署负责保护事务的助理高级专员埃德姆·沃索尔努 (Edem Wosornu) 表示：“我们对这些人返回感到担忧，因为被送回缅甸的人可能面临严重风险，而且该组织中的一些人可能需要国际保护。”

paras.en: Although Malaysian authorities said the process was voluntary, she noted that those returned had been held in immigration detention.
paras.zh: 尽管马来西亚当局表示这一过程是自愿的，但她指出，那些被遣返的人已被关押在移民拘留所中。

paras.en: “This raises serious questions about whether decisions to return were genuinely free and informed,” she said. “UNHCR did not have access to the individuals to assess this.”
paras.zh: “这引发了严重的问题，即返回的决定是否真正自由且知情，”她说。 “难民署无法接触到这些人来评估此事。”

paras.en: The Rohingya are a mainly Muslim ethnic minority group in Myanmar, a predominantly Buddhist nation where the military and various resistance groups are locked in civil war.
paras.zh: 罗兴亚人是缅甸一个以穆斯林为主的少数民族群体，缅甸是一个以佛教为主的国家，军队和各种抵抗组织陷入内战。

paras.en: Myanmar’s military, which seized power in a coup in 2021, has repeatedly targeted the Rohingya community, notably in 2017, when a widely condemned military operation in Rakhine state forced several hundred thousand people to flee to other countries in Southeast Asia.
paras.zh: 缅甸军方在 2021 年的政变中夺取政权，多次以罗辛亚社区为目标，特别是 2017 年，当时若开邦发生的军事行动受到广泛谴责，迫使数十万人逃往东南亚其他国家。

paras.en: Today, more than a million Rohingya have settled in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh.
paras.zh: 如今，超过一百万罗兴亚人已在孟加拉国考克斯巴扎尔定居。

paras.en: While UNHCR fully recognized Malaysia’s sovereign responsibility to manage asylum and migration, it urged authorities to ensure that returns are subject to robust safeguards, such as individual assessments and access to protection procedures.
paras.zh: 虽然难民署充分认识到马来西亚管理庇护和移民的主权责任，但它敦促当局确保回返者受到强有力的保障，例如个人评估和获得保护程序。

paras.en: Decisions to return must be voluntary and assessed outside detention settings, the agency noted.
paras.zh: 该机构指出，返回的决定必须是自愿的，并在拘留场所之外进行评估。

paras.en: Moreover, no one should be returned to a country where they may face persecution, torture or other serious threats to their life and freedom.
paras.zh: 此外，任何人都不应被遣返到可能面临迫害、酷刑或生命和自由受到其他严重威胁的国家。

paras.en: UNHCR stressed that until conditions in Myanmar allow for safe, dignified and sustainable returns, States must continue to provide access to asylum and uphold international protection obligations.
paras.zh: 难民署强调，在缅甸的条件允许安全、有尊严和可持续的回返之前，各国必须继续提供庇护并履行国际保护义务。

paras.en: The UN agency highlighted the need for greater regional and international support towards achieving both a political solution and an end to hostilities in Myanmar.
paras.zh: 该联合国机构强调需要提供更多的区域和国际支持，以实现缅甸的政治解决和结束敌对行动。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the UN's top humanitarian deplored an airstrike on a market in Rakhine state on Tuesday that killed and injured dozens of people.
paras.zh: 与此同时，联合国最高人道主义事务高级专员对周二对若开邦一个市场造成数十人死伤的空袭表示遗憾。

paras.en: “Civilians must be protected,” Emergency Relief Coordinator Tom Fletcher wrote in a post on social media, stressing that "international humanitarian law must be respected,”
paras.zh: “平民必须受到保护，”紧急救济协调员汤姆·弗莱彻在社交媒体上发帖写道，并强调“国际人道法必须得到尊重”

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres strongly condemned the airstrike and called for those responsible to be held to account.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯强烈谴责此次空袭，并呼吁追究责任人的责任。

articles.title: Merson: Man City should have trophies taken away

paras.en: Manchester City charges: Paul Merson believes club should have trophies taken away
paras.zh: 曼城指控：保罗·默森认为俱乐部应该拿走奖杯

paras.en: Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
paras.zh: 请使用Chrome浏览器以获得更方便的视频播放器

paras.en: Following Man City being found guilty of all charges related to serious breaches of Premier League financial rules by an independent commission, Paul Merson shares what he believes should happen next. The club continue to deny the breaches.
paras.zh: 在曼城被一个独立委员会判定犯有与严重违反英超联赛财务规则有关的所有指控后，保罗·默森分享了他认为接下来应该发生的事情。俱乐部继续否认违规行为。

articles.title: Five different takes on the Man City saga by Sky Sports reporters

paras.en: Man City charges: Five different takes on the financial breaches saga by Sky Sports reporters
paras.zh: 曼城指控：天空体育记者对财务违规事件有五种不同看法

paras.en: Man City have been found guilty of all charges related to serious breaches of Premier League financial rules by an independent commission; City have confirmed they will appeal against the ruling and have until Friday October 2 to do so
paras.zh: 独立委员会判定曼城犯有与严重违反英超联赛财务规则有关的所有指控；曼城已确认他们将对裁决提出上诉，并在 10 月 2 日星期五之前提出上诉

paras.en: Sky Sports News reporters discuss how Manchester City being found guilty of all charges related to serious breaches of Premier League financial rules unfolded and where the situation develops from here...
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻记者讨论了曼城是如何被判犯有与严重违反英超联赛财务规则相关的所有指控的，以及事态的发展……

paras.en: The club continue to deny the breaches, with chief executive Ferran Soriano calling the process a "Premier League conspiracy theory" in a video message to players and staff.
paras.zh: 俱乐部继续否认这些违规行为，首席执行官费兰·索里亚诺在给球员和工作人员的视频信息中称这一过程为“英超阴谋论”。

paras.en: The club have confirmed they will appeal against the ruling and have until Friday to do so.
paras.zh: 俱乐部已确认他们将对裁决提出上诉，并必须在周五之前提出上诉。

paras.en: Kaveh Solhekol: Potential punishments and timeline for conclusion
paras.zh: Kaveh Solhekol：潜在的惩罚和结论时间表

paras.en: "If you look at the Premier League's own handbook, it says that the commission has the right to punish the club with a points deduction, a fine, a transfer ban, other sporting sanctions, and expulsion from the Premier League. It could be a combination of any of those.
paras.zh: “如果你看一下英超联赛自己的手册，它说委员会有权对俱乐部进行扣分、罚款、转会禁令、其他体育制裁以及开除英超联赛的惩罚。这可能是其中任何一种的组合。

paras.en: "There will be a further hearing with the independent commission to address the issue of sanctions, where the Premier League will put forward what they think the punishment should be and Manchester City will argue their case.
paras.zh: “独立委员会将举行进一步听证会来解决制裁问题，英超联赛将提出他们认为应该采取的惩罚措施，曼城将就他们的案子进行辩论。

paras.en: "Then, the commission will go away and decide what the punishment should be.
paras.zh: “然后，委员会将离开并决定应该采取什么惩罚措施。

paras.en: "We are not going to find out what the punishment is anytime soon.
paras.zh: “我们不会很快知道惩罚是什么。

paras.en: "I sense, reading between the lines, that the Premier League wants this concluded this season. Any points deductions can be applied this season.
paras.zh: “我从字里行间感觉到，英超希望这个赛季能够结束。任何扣分都可以在本赛季应用。

paras.en: "The Premier League is saying that Manchester City have the right to appeal the commission's filings and they have until Friday October 2 to exercise that right.
paras.zh: “英超联赛表示，曼城有权对委员会的文件提出上诉，他们必须在 10 月 2 日星期五之前行使这项权利。

paras.en: "When it comes to an appeal, you can't just say 'I'm angry, I'm going to appeal.' You have to have strong legal grounds."
paras.zh: “当谈到上诉时，你不能只是说‘我很生气，我要上诉。’”你必须有强有力的法律依据。”

paras.en: Amar Mehta: Could there be further litigation against Man City?
paras.zh: 阿马尔·梅塔：是否会对曼城提起进一步的诉讼？

paras.en: "Barristers and lawyers across the country are working with Premier League clubs over the prospect of bringing further litigation against Manchester City, Sky Sports News understands.
paras.zh: 据天空体育新闻了解，全国各地的大律师和律师正在与英超俱乐部合作，讨论对曼城提起进一步诉讼的可能性。

paras.en: "It is understood that clubs have instructed some of the top barristers in the UK to assess what legal options are potentially at their disposal, following the independent commission's verdict.
paras.zh: “据了解，在独立委员会做出裁决后，俱乐部已指示英国的一些顶级大律师评估他们可能采取的法律选择。

paras.en: "No litigation has been filed yet, with sources telling Sky Sports News that clubs will wait for the outcome of the appeals process."
paras.zh: “尚未提起诉讼，消息人士告诉天空体育新闻，俱乐部将等待上诉程序的结果。”

paras.en: Rob Dorsett: What happens if City are expelled from the Premier League?
paras.zh: 罗布·多塞特：如果曼城被英超开除会怎样？

paras.en: "The independent commission has a lot of sanctioning options. There are heavy fines, there are points deductions, and at the extreme, expulsion from the Premier League.
paras.zh: “独立委员会有很多制裁选项。有巨额罚款，有扣分，最严重的是被驱逐出英超联赛。”

paras.en: "If City are to end up playing in the Championship, the only way they can get there is if they're given a very large points deduction, which means they are relegated on the field, if you like.
paras.zh: “如果曼城最终想参加英冠联赛，那么他们进入英冠的唯一方法就是被大幅扣分，如果你愿意的话，这意味着他们会在球场上降级。

paras.en: "If they're expelled from the Premier League, they're no longer a Premier League club. The independent panel cannot recommend what level they would rejoin the football pyramid at.
paras.zh: “如果他们被英超开除，他们就不再是英超俱乐部。独立小组无法建议他们重新加入足球金字塔的级别。

paras.en: "It's written into the EFL laws that any club that wants to rejoin the EFL, which is a separate body from the Premier League, has to rejoin at League Two, unless there's a vote by the member clubs, because the EFL, like the Premier League, represents the member clubs.
paras.zh: “EFL法律规定，任何想要重新加入EFL（与英超联赛不同的机构）的俱乐部都必须重新加入二级联赛，除非成员俱乐部投票，因为EFL和英超联赛一样代表成员俱乐部。

paras.en: "The clubs would have to have a vote on where they wanted Manchester City to rejoin the football pyramid. Would those clubs want them to rejoin in the Championship? Can you imagine the Championship clubs wanting Manchester City to be in there with them, with all of their power?
paras.zh: “各俱乐部必须就他们希望曼城重新加入足球金字塔的位置进行投票。这些俱乐部会希望他们重新加入英冠联赛吗？你能想象英冠俱乐部希望曼城全力以赴与他们并肩作战吗？

paras.en: "You have to remember as well that it causes problems for the numbers. If they were reintegrated at the Championship level, well, there would be 25 teams in the Championship. That wouldn't work. What would it mean for relegation going forward as well? It's very, very complicated."
paras.zh: “你还必须记住，这会给数据带来问题。如果他们在英冠级别重新整合，那么，英冠将有25支球队。这是行不通的。这对未来的降级意味着什么？这非常非常复杂。”

paras.en: Ben Ransom: Verdict has sent shockwaves through football
paras.zh: 本·兰塞姆：判决给足球界带来了冲击

paras.en: "The Premier League statement is really damning, with some really extreme language and this is where it gets really damaging for Man City as the commission says they found some witnesses gave false evidence and that when they did the accounts, they were overspending both the Premier League and UEFA's limits.
paras.zh: “英超联赛的声明确实令人震惊，其中包含一些非常极端的语言，这对曼城来说是真正有害的，因为委员会表示，他们发现一些证人提供了虚假证据，而且当他们做账目时，他们超出了英超联赛和欧足联的限额。

paras.en: "And all in all, with the findings so heavily against Man City, it has sent shockwaves through football. It is incredibly damaging and you can understand why everyone in football is looking at this as such a huge moment not just for Man City, but in the history of the Premier League.
paras.zh: “总而言之，调查结果对曼城的影响如此之大，给整个足球界带来了冲击。这是令人难以置信的破坏性，你可以理解为什么足球界的每个人都认为这不仅是曼城的一个重要时刻，也是英超历史上的一个重要时刻。”

paras.en: "City are clearly really hurt, but they have been working on their defence since the article in Der Spiegel in 2018 and it is clear in Ferran Soriano's words that he thinks the panel has glossed over the Man City evidence, which he says is irrefutable.
paras.zh: “曼城显然确实受到了伤害，但自 2018 年《明镜周刊》发表文章以来，他们一直在努力防守，从费兰·索里亚诺的话中可以明显看出，他认为专家组掩盖了曼城的证据，他说这些证据是无可辩驳的。

paras.en: "But the panel did look at their evidence and said that parts of Man City's case was dishonest, which is incredibly damaging."
paras.zh: “但专家组确实审查了他们的证据，并表示曼城案件的部分内容是不诚实的，这是极其具有破坏性的。”

paras.en: Several Man City sponsors refuse to comment on Premier League findings
paras.zh: 几家曼城赞助商拒绝对英超联赛的调查结果发表评论

paras.en: Exclusive by Sky Sports News reporters Anthony Joseph and Adrian Kajumba:
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻记者安东尼·约瑟夫和阿德里安·卡琼巴独家报道：

paras.en: "Several Manchester City sponsors are standing by the club in the wake of the guilty verdict.
paras.zh: “在有罪判决后，曼城的几位赞助商都支持俱乐部。

paras.en: "Lucozade, Kellogg's and Revolut have all told Sky Sports News they are not commenting on the independent commission's findings while the process remains ongoing."
paras.zh: “Lucozade、家乐氏和 Revolut 都告诉天空体育新闻，他们不会对独立委员会的调查结果发表评论，而这一过程仍在进行中。”

articles.title: Guardiola sends message to Man City after guilty verdict

paras.en: Man City Premier League charges: Pep Guardiola sends message of support to former club
paras.zh: 曼城英超联赛指控：瓜迪奥拉向前俱乐部发出支持信息

paras.en: Man City have been found guilty of all charges related to serious breaches of Premier League financial rules by an independent commission; City were charged by the Premier League with more than 100 breaches in February 2023; City continue to deny the breaches and intend to appeal decision
paras.zh: 独立委员会判定曼城犯有与严重违反英超联赛财务规则有关的所有指控； 2023 年 2 月，曼城被英超联赛指控有超过 100 次违规行为；市政府继续否认违规行为并打算对决定提出上诉

paras.en: Pep Guardiola has posted a message of support to Manchester City's players, staff, fans and ownership saying: "We will get through this together. I love you all."
paras.zh: 瓜迪奥拉向曼城的球员、工作人员、球迷和老板发布了一条支持信息，他说：“我们将一起度过难关。我爱你们所有人。”

paras.en: Man City were found guilty of all charges related to serious breaches of Premier League financial rules by an independent commission.
paras.zh: 独立委员会判定曼城犯有与严重违反英超联赛财务规则有关的所有指控。

paras.en: The independent commission found that between 2009/10 and 2017/18, Manchester City arranged "sham" contracts with a number of its commercial partners as part of a "disguised funding scheme" to artificially inflate the club's revenues by £830m.
paras.zh: 独立委员会发现，在2009/10年至2017/18年期间，曼城与其一些商业合作伙伴签订了“虚假”合同，作为“变相融资计划”的一部分，人为地将俱乐部收入虚增8.3亿英镑。

paras.en: The club continue to deny the breaches, with chief executive Ferran Soriano calling the process a "Premier League conspiracy theory" in a video message to players and staff. The club have confirmed they will appeal against the ruling and have until Friday October 2 to do so.
paras.zh: 俱乐部继续否认这些违规行为，首席执行官费兰·索里亚诺在给球员和工作人员的视频信息中称这一过程为“英超阴谋论”。俱乐部已确认他们将对裁决提出上诉，并在 10 月 2 日星期五之前提出上诉。

paras.en: Guardiola, who was City manager between 2016 and 2026, posted on social media: "I want every single Manchester City fan across the world to know I am here; more than ever. I am, always have been, always will, be behind my club, my owner, my chairman, Ferran, the players, staff, Enzo [Maresca] and you, our unique supporters.
paras.zh: 2016年至2026年间担任曼城主帅的瓜迪奥拉在社交媒体上发帖称：“我希望全世界每一位曼城球迷都知道我在这里，比以往任何时候都更重要。我、一直、永远都会支持我的俱乐部、我的老板、我的主席、费兰、球员、工作人员、恩佐[马雷斯卡]和你们，我们独特的支持者。”

paras.en: "Let me be clear: we will get through this together. I love you all."
paras.zh: “让我明确一点：我们将一起度过难关。我爱你们所有人。”

paras.en: What did the independent commission find?
paras.zh: 独立委员会发现了什么？

paras.en: - Manchester City arranged "sham" contracts with a number of its commercial partners as part of a "disguised funding scheme" to artificially inflate the club's revenues by £830m.
paras.zh: - 曼城与一些商业合作伙伴签订了“虚假”合同，作为“变相融资计划”的一部分，人为地将俱乐部收入虚增 8.3 亿英镑。

paras.en: - The club filed accounts that concealed the true state of its finances.
paras.zh: - 俱乐部提交的账目隐瞒了其真实的财务状况。

paras.en: - Manchester City were significantly in breach of both the Premier League's and UEFA's spending limits and broke "well over 100" Premier League regulations.
paras.zh: - 曼城严重违反了英超联赛和欧足联的支出限制，并违反了“远远超过 100 项”英超联赛规定。

paras.en: - Manchester City failed to co-operate and act in good faith towards the league during the investigation, with three out of four alleged breaches upheld and one charge not proven
paras.zh: - 曼城在调查期间未能与联盟合作并真诚行事，四分之三的涉嫌违规行为得到维持，一项指控尚未得到证实

paras.en: The commission also said it was "regrettable" that a decision had taken so long to reach, with the hearing having taken place between September and December 2024.
paras.zh: 该委员会还表示，听证会是在 2024 年 9 月至 12 月期间举行的，所以花了这么长时间才做出决定，这“令人遗憾”。

paras.en: A Manchester City statement released on Tuesday read: "Manchester City FC is both disappointed and surprised by the opinion of the Premier League commission, that has been published today.
paras.zh: 曼城周二发布的声明中写道：“曼城足球俱乐部对今天发布的英超委员会的意见感到既失望又惊讶。

paras.en: "The club is innocent of the accusations made by the Premier League and a comprehensive body of irrefutable evidence exists in support of all of its positions, relating to this case. The club will therefore be relentless, and where necessary proactive, in any and all appropriate regulatory and legal forums.
paras.zh: “俱乐部对英超联赛的指控是无辜的，并且有大量无可辩驳的证据支持其与此案相关的所有立场。因此，俱乐部将在任何和所有适当的监管和法律论坛上坚持不懈，并在必要时采取积极主动的态度。”

paras.en: "The Premier League process remains ongoing, with significant elements uncompleted. Manchester City FC will now pursue the appeal avenues open to it, on the basis that the opinion contains clear material errors, of law, principle and fact, and is unsafe.
paras.zh: “英超联赛的程序仍在进行中，有重要内容尚未完成。曼城足球俱乐部现在将寻求对其开放的上诉途径，因为该意见包含明显的法律、原则和事实方面的重大错误，并且是不安全的。”

paras.en: "The club has diligently respected due process for eight years on the basis that the Premier League board and executive would behave as an independent, impartial and fair-minded regulator, free from partisan influence.
paras.zh: “俱乐部八年来一直恪守正当程序，其基础是英超联赛董事会和高管将作为独立、公正和公正的监管者，不受党派影响。

paras.en: "The club is obviously restricted in what it can say further until all future proceedings are complete."
paras.zh: “在所有未来的诉讼程序完成之前，俱乐部的进一步言论显然受到限制。”

paras.en: Manchester City's statement erroneously refers to a Premier League commission. It is an independent commission.
paras.zh: 曼城的声明错误地提到了英超委员会。它是一个独立委员会。

articles.title: British police find no explosives in vehicles of men detained near base used by U.S.
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: No explosives were found in vehicles searched after five men were arrested in connection with a huge security operation near an air base the U.S. Air Force uses to facilitate strikes on Iran, British counterterrorism police confirmed Tuesday.
paras.zh: 英国反恐警察周二证实，五名男子因参与美国空军用于协助袭击伊朗的空军基地附近的大规模安全行动而被捕，搜查的车辆中没有发现爆炸物。

paras.en: In an update explaining Monday’s decision to release all five suspects who were arrested on terrorism and explosives charges on bail, Laurence Taylor, Britain’s head of counterterrorism policing, said “a quantity” of gasoline was recovered from three vans near RAF Fairford.
paras.zh: 英国反恐警务负责人劳伦斯·泰勒(Laurence Taylor)在解释周一决定释放所有因恐怖主义和爆炸物指控被捕的五名嫌疑人的最新消息中表示，从英国皇家空军费尔福德附近的三辆货车中发现了“一定数量”的汽油。

paras.en: “Those vehicles have been subject to extensive examination, with the support of military assets and forensic experts, and we can confirm that no improvised explosive devices were found,” he said, adding that investigators had searched properties in London.
paras.zh: 他说：“在军事资产和法医专家的支持下，这些车辆已经接受了广泛的检查，我们可以确认没有发现简易爆炸装置。”他补充说，调查人员已搜查了伦敦的房产。

paras.en: Taylor said it was an “investigative decision” to release the men on bail, “grounded in experience and careful considerations of policing powers.”
paras.zh: 泰勒表示，保释这些人是一项“调查决定”，“基于经验和对治安权力的仔细考虑”。

paras.en: No charges have been filed against the men.
paras.zh: 目前尚未对这些人提出任何指控。

paras.en: President Donald Trump told reporters Tuesday that he was disappointed about that decision.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周二告诉记者，他对这一决定感到失望。

paras.en: “I’m just disappointed that they caught terrorists — they did a good job, and then they sort of let them go,” he said, adding, “How do you give bail to a terrorist?”
paras.zh: “我只是对他们抓获恐怖分子感到失望——他们做得很好，然后又放了他们，”他说，并补充道，“你如何保释恐怖分子？”

paras.en: Asked if it was a long-standing investigation, Trump replied, “A long standing. Yeah, we were involved in it.”
paras.zh: 当被问及这是否是一项长期调查时，特朗普回答说：“长期调查。是的，我们参与其中。”

paras.en: “They put them out on bail. I assume they have, they have them watched closely. But these were serious people, seriously bad people, and they should not have done that,” he added.
paras.zh: “他们将他们保释了。我想他们已经这么做了，他们对他们进行了密切监视。但这些人都是严肃的人，非常坏的人，他们不应该这样做，”他补充道。

paras.en: Trump also said he was surprised about the decision to release the men on bail on Monday. “I would have said, ‘Don’t let them have bail,’” Trump said in the Oval Office. “I’m surprised that they released them. I wouldn’t have done that.”
paras.zh: 特朗普还表示，他对周一保释这些人的决定感到惊讶。 “我会说，‘不要让他们保释，’”特朗普在椭圆形办公室说道。 “我很惊讶他们竟然释放了他们。我不会那么做。”

paras.en: Trump indicated U.S. officials were cooperating with their British counterparts on the case.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，美国官员正在与英国同行就此案进行合作。

paras.en: “Look, they’ve been very good. They are working with us very closely,” he said, adding that the U.S. knew “everything” about the suspects.
paras.zh: “看，他们非常好。他们正在与我们非常密切地合作，”他说，并补充说美国了解嫌疑人的“一切”。

paras.en: Separately, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the incident “clearly involves the hands of a foreign actor” — an allegation British officials haven’t confirmed.
paras.zh: 另外，国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，这起事件“显然涉及外国演员”——英国官员尚未证实这一指控。

paras.en: The five men, all British nationals in their 20s from London, were arrested Sunday on suspicion of terrorism and explosives offenses after three vehicles were seen moving toward RAF Fairford, a British air force station about 90 minutes west of London.
paras.zh: 这五名男子都是来自伦敦的 20 多岁英国公民，他们于周日因涉嫌恐怖主义和爆炸罪而被捕，原因是有人看到三辆汽车驶向距离伦敦以西约 90 分钟路程的英国皇家空军费尔福德基地。

paras.en: Counterterrorism police took over the case after a major incident was declared, disrupting life in the normally quiet, rural community of the Cotswolds.
paras.zh: 反恐警察在宣布发生重大事件后接手了此案，扰乱了科茨沃尔德通常安静的乡村社区的生活。

paras.en: Counterterrorism police said Sunday that the men had been arrested on suspicion of committing offenses under the Explosives Act, British legislation dating to 1875 that regulates manufacturing, keeping, selling, carrying and importing gunpowder and explosive substances. The men were further suspected of preparation of a terrorist act.
paras.zh: 反恐警察周日表示，这些人因涉嫌违反《爆炸物法》而被捕，该法是英国于 1875 年制定的立法，旨在规范火药和爆炸物的制造、保存、销售、运输和进口。这些人还涉嫌准备恐怖活动。

paras.en: “What seems to be happening is that you’ve got a developing investigation where the custody clock for the terrorism arrest, which is a very long custody clock, has stopped,” said Max Hill, a former director of public prosecutions of England and Wales.
paras.zh: 英格兰和威尔士前检察长马克斯·希尔 (Max Hill) 表示：“目前的情况似乎是，调查正在进行中，逮捕恐怖主义分子的拘留时间（这是一个非常长的拘留时间）已经停止了。”

paras.en: In the U.K., police can usually hold people for up to 24 hours before they have to charge or release them, although officers can apply to extend that time if they suspect a serious crime has been committed. Suspects arrested under the Terrorism Act can be held without charge for up to 14 days.
paras.zh: 在英国，警方通常可以将人拘留长达 24 小时，然后才必须指控或释放他们，不过如果警察怀疑发生了严重犯罪，可以申请延长这一时间。根据《恐怖主义法》被捕的嫌疑人可在不受到指控的情况下被拘留最多 14 天。

paras.en: “So there must be an element of uncertainty about whether ultimately any terrorism-related charges are going to emerge,” Hill said in a telephone interview Tuesday. Releasing the suspects on bail also doesn’t mean they won’t be taken back into custody, he added. “But it does indicate that there’s just not enough for a formal remand application.”
paras.zh: “因此，最终是否会出现任何与恐怖主义相关的指控，肯定存在一定的不确定性，”希尔周二在接受电话采访时表示。他补充说，保释嫌疑人并不意味着他们不会被重新拘留。 “但这确实表明，正式还押申请还不够。”

paras.en: The incident prompted questions about whether a foreign actor could be involved — in particular, Iran. Its Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps warned Britain this summer that RAF Fairford could be a “legitimate target” months after then-Prime Minister Keir Starmer gave permission for the U.S. to use its bases for “specific and limited defensive” operations against Iran.
paras.zh: 这一事件引发了人们的疑问：是否有外国势力参与其中——尤其是伊朗。今年夏天，英国伊斯兰革命卫队警告英国，英国皇家空军费尔福德可能成为“合法目标”，几个月前，时任英国首相基尔·斯塔默允许美国使用其基地对伊朗进行“具体和有限的防御”行动。

paras.en: The Iranian Embassy in Britain denied any involvement Monday.
paras.zh: 伊朗驻英国大使馆周一否认与此事有任何关系。

paras.en: In an appearance on Fox News later Monday, Rubio said, “What happened, what almost happened, what could have happened in the U.K. over the weekend is a very serious situation.”
paras.zh: 周一晚些时候，卢比奥在福克斯新闻节目中表示，“周末在英国发生的事情、差点发生的事情以及可能发生的事情是一个非常严重的情况。”

paras.en: “There’s a lot more news that’ll come out on this in the days to come,” he added.
paras.zh: “未来几天将会有更多关于此事的消息发布，”他补充道。

paras.en: Taylor said that “it was simply not possible for me to go into detail about every strand that we are looking at and all of the intelligence we have got,” which he said wasn’t unusual for such an investigation.
paras.zh: 泰勒说，“我根本不可能详细了解我们正在研究的每一条线索以及我们获得的所有情报”，他说这对于此类调查来说并不罕见。

paras.en: “It is unusual for it to be as visible as it is in this incident,” he said, adding that his team was working with international partners.
paras.zh: 他说：“它在这起事件中如此明显，这是不寻常的。”他补充说，他的团队正在与国际合作伙伴合作。

articles.title: Settlers clash with Israeli forces to block Palestinian family’s return home
articles.author: Matt Bradley

paras.en: TEL AVIV — Dozens of Jewish settlers repulsed an attempt by Israeli security forces to return a Palestinian family to its home in the occupied West Bank before setting fire to its property and car.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫——数十名犹太定居者击退了以色列安全部队试图将一个巴勒斯坦家庭送回被占领约旦河西岸的家的企图，然后放火焚烧了其财产和汽车。

paras.en: The Tubassi family was forced to leave its home in July following a weekslong siege by violent settlers in the West Bank town of Jalud. But after security forces tried to enforce an order by Israel’s High Court of Justice to facilitate the family’s return Monday night, an extended and violent confrontation ensued, Mahmoud Tubassi, 60, said.
paras.zh: 在约旦河西岸城镇贾鲁德遭受暴力定居者长达一周的围困后，图巴西一家于七月被迫离开家园。但 60 岁的马哈茂德·图巴西 (Mahmoud Tubassi) 表示，周一晚上，安全部队试图执行以色列高等法院的命令，为一家人返回提供便利，随后发生了一场旷日持久的暴力冲突。

paras.en: “I went through a terrifying experience that I could never have imagined,” he said in a telephone interview Tuesday. “We saw death with our own eyes. Death came very close to us at the hands of the settlers.”
paras.zh: “我经历了一次我从未想象过的可怕经历，”他在周二的电话采访中说道。 “我们亲眼目睹了死亡。死亡在定居者手中离我们非常近。”

paras.en: It is the second time that Tubassi and his wife, Aida Ahmed Abdullah, 51, have suffered at the hands of Jewish settlers in just over a month. On Aug. 28, masked settlers attacked and injured them and an NBC News crew that was interviewing them. The crew were injured and Abdullah was beaten unconscious but has since recovered.
paras.zh: 这是图巴西和他 51 岁的妻子艾达·艾哈迈德·阿卜杜拉在短短一个多月内第二次遭受犹太定居者的迫害。 8 月 28 日，蒙面定居者袭击并伤害了他们以及正在采访他们的 NBC 新闻工作人员。船员受伤，阿卜杜拉被打昏，但现已康复。

paras.en: Tubassi said their latest ordeal began just before midnight Monday when Abdel Azim Wadi, the mayor of the nearby village of Qusra, which has also faced serious settler violence, told him that Israeli officials would accompany him, his wife and their son Wael Tubassi, 33, to their home in Jalud.
paras.zh: 图巴西说，他们最近的磨难始于周一午夜之前，附近库斯拉村的村长阿卜杜勒·阿齐姆·瓦迪 (Abdel Azim Wadi) 告诉他，以色列官员将陪伴他、他的妻子和 33 岁的儿子瓦尔·图巴西 (Wael Tubassi) 前往贾鲁德的家。库斯拉村也面临着严重的定居者暴力。

paras.en: After they were picked up by four Israeli vehicles, they were driven the short distance to their home — two structures that sit in a small walled compound atop a hill, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，他们被四辆以色列车辆接走后，经过很短的距离就回到了自己的家——两栋建筑坐落在山顶的一个小围墙院落里。

paras.en: As the family arrived, settlers started throwing stones at the armed police and military, who responded with tear gas and stun grenades, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，当这家人到达时，定居者开始向武装警察和军队投掷石块，武装警察和军队则用催泪瓦斯和眩晕手榴弹予以回应。

paras.en: “They could shoot rubber bullets, they could fire live bullets in air,” Tubassi said of the Israeli security forces’ response. “They could use force, but they didn’t do anything, unfortunately,” he added.
paras.zh: “他们可以发射橡皮子弹，他们可以在空中发射实弹，”图巴西谈到以色列安全部队的反应时说道。 “他们可以使用武力，但不幸的是他们没有采取任何行动，”他补充道。

paras.en: Describing the violence as “severe,” the Israel Defense Forces said in a statement that “violent rioters began arriving” after the Tubassis entered their home.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军在一份声明中将暴力事件描述为“严重”，并表示，在图巴西人进入他们的家后，“暴力骚乱者开始到来”。

paras.en: “They set fire to the neighboring house and subsequently entered the family’s home, where severe violence began,” the statement said, adding that the rioters “blocked access roads with large rocks, set tires on fire, threw rocks at security forces, and set fire to Palestinian structures and vehicles.”
paras.zh: 声明称：“他们放火烧毁了邻近的房屋，随后进入了这家人的家，在那里开始了严重的暴力行为。”声明还补充说，骚乱者“用大石头堵塞了道路，点燃轮胎，向安全部队投掷石块，并放火焚烧巴勒斯坦建筑物和车辆。”

paras.en: As a result, “three Border Police officers were injured and a security forces vehicle was damaged,” the IDF statement said.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军声明称，结果“三名边防警察受伤，一辆安全部队车辆被损坏”。

paras.en: The IDF did not immediately respond to NBC News’ request for comment on whether stun grenades and tear gas had been used to try to disperse the rioters.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军没有立即回应 NBC 新闻就是否使用眩晕手榴弹和催泪瓦斯来试图驱散骚乱者发表评论的请求。

paras.en: After the settlers entered the property, Tubassi said, his family was urged by the Israeli security forces to go to the roof, where the settlers followed them. Several of the soldiers and officers formed a physical barrier between the family and the settlers, Tubassi said.
paras.zh: 图巴西说，定居者进入该房产后，以色列安全部队敦促他的家人前往屋顶，定居者也跟着他们。图巴西说，几名士兵和军官在这家人和定居者之间形成了物理屏障。

paras.en: Tubassi said the security officials told them to get back in an armored car and drove them to safety.
paras.zh: 图巴西说，安全官员让他们乘坐装甲车返回，并将他们带到安全的地方。

paras.en: The security forces’ failure to return the Tubassis to their home comes as settler violence in the occupied West Bank has become a growing international embarrassment for Israeli leaders, who have struggled to explain how Israel’s formidable military has repeatedly found itself outmatched by hundreds of lightly armed young men.
paras.zh: 安全部队未能将图巴西人送回家园之际，被占领的约旦河西岸定居者的暴力行为已经成为以色列领导人日益感到的国际尴尬，他们一直在努力解释以色列强大的军队如何屡屡被数百名轻武装的年轻人击败。

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu condemned the attacks in a statement Tuesday and called on the rioters to be prosecuted. The “handful of rioters are not representative of the law-abiding settler public in Judea and Samaria,” he said, using the biblical and historical term for the West Bank.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡周二在一份声明中谴责袭击事件，并呼吁起诉骚乱者。他说，“少数骚乱者不能代表犹太和撒马利亚守法的定居者公众”，他用的是约旦河西岸的圣经和历史术语。

paras.en: The statement echoed his comments at the United Nations General Assembly last week, in which he rejected “vigilantism” by Jewish settlers in the West Bank but sought to minimize the violence, suggesting the problem only involved “a handful of juvenile delinquents, about 150 in number, who throw stones, who down olive trees, occasionally they light some fires.”
paras.zh: 该声明呼应了他上周在联合国大会上的言论，其中他拒绝接受约旦河西岸犹太定居者的“私刑主义”，但力求将暴力降到最低，暗示问题只涉及“少数青少年犯罪分子，人数约 150 人，他们投掷石块，从橄榄树上掉下来，偶尔还会生火。”

paras.en: According to the U.N. Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), some 6,500 Palestinians have been displaced due to settler attacks in the West Bank since 2023. Between Jan. 1 and July 24, Israeli forces or settlers killed 76 Palestinians, according to the latest data available from OCHA. Three Israelis were killed over the same period, the data shows.
paras.zh: 据联合国人道主义事务协调办公室 (OCHA) 称，自 2023 年以来，约 6,500 名巴勒斯坦人因定居者在西岸的袭击而流离失所。根据 OCHA 提供的最新数据，1 月 1 日至 7 月 24 日期间，以色列军队或定居者杀害了 76 名巴勒斯坦人。数据显示，三名以色列人在同一时期被杀。

paras.en: The agency recorded nearly 200 settler attacks that resulted in Palestinian casualties or property damage in August alone.
paras.zh: 该机构记录了仅 8 月份就发生了近 200 起定居者袭击事件，造成巴勒斯坦人伤亡或财产损失。

paras.en: Israel has regularly accused the U.N. of siding against it. But many governments around the world consider the West Bank to be illegally occupied by Israel.
paras.zh: 以色列经常指责联合国站在一边反对它。但世界许多国家政府认为约旦河西岸被以色列非法占领。

paras.en: Monday night’s police and military action in Jalud was an attempt to execute an order by Israel’s High Court of Justice, which had instructed the “relevant authorities” earlier this month to ensure that the Tubassis return to their home within two weeks.
paras.zh: 周一晚上在贾鲁德的警察和军事行动是为了执行以色列高等法院的一项命令，该法院本月早些时候指示“有关当局”确保图巴斯一家在两周内返回家园。

paras.en: The court also demanded that security forces explain to the Tubassis and another Palestinian family “why they are not working to return the family to their homes and why they are not removing the barriers and obstacles blocking access to the houses.”
paras.zh: 法院还要求安全部队向图巴斯一家和另一个巴勒斯坦家庭解释“为什么他们不努力让家人返回家园，以及为什么他们不清除阻碍进入房屋的障碍和障碍”。

paras.en: It was unclear Tuesday if or when the police and military would try to execute the court’s order again, and the Israel Defense Forces said it had no details about how the issue would be handled in the near term.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚周二警方和军方是否或何时会再次尝试执行法院的命令，以色列国防军表示，没有关于短期内如何处理该问题的细节。

paras.en: “The Israelis didn’t say anything to me” about future plans, Tubassi said in the phone call from his father’s home nearby where the family has been staying. “I don’t know if they will let me go back.”
paras.zh: 图巴西在家人居住的附近父亲家中打电话说，“以色列人没有对我说任何关于未来计划的事情”。 “不知道他们会不会放我回去。”

paras.en: Whether they will be able to return after last night’s fire remains to be seen as the home has been badly damaged.
paras.zh: 由于房屋已严重受损，他们能否在昨晚的火灾后返回仍有待观察。

paras.en: “What happened was a nightmare for us,” Tubassi said. “And now we are living through other nightmares, because our loss has become so great. The state of Israel has not stopped these thugs from taking our homes and our land and from killing us.”
paras.zh: “发生的事情对我们来说是一场噩梦，”图巴西说。 “现在我们正经历着其他噩梦，因为我们的损失变得如此巨大。以色列国并没有阻止这些暴徒夺走我们的家园和土地并杀害我们。”

articles.title: Israel-bound flight diverted amid reports a pilot was stabbed in the cockpit
articles.author: Matt Bradley

paras.en: A passenger plane from Dubai to Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday, with witness accounts describing a bloody onboard altercation that forced the flight to make a sudden and extreme descent.
paras.zh: 周三，一架从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的客机在沙特阿拉伯紧急降落，目击者描述了机上发生的血腥争吵，迫使飞机突然急剧下降。

paras.en: The incident briefly raised fears of hijacking, and the Israeli military scrambled at least two jets in response. Officials said they had not ruled out the possibility that it was terrorism-related.
paras.zh: 该事件短暂地引发了对劫持的担忧，以色列军方紧急紧急升空至少两架飞机作为回应。官员们表示，不排除这起事件与恐怖主义有关的可能性。

paras.en: Motti Cohen Or, a passenger of the flight, told NBC News that he heard a woman shouting, “Someone is stabbing someone in the cockpit.”
paras.zh: 该航班的乘客莫蒂·科恩·奥尔 (Motti Cohen Or) 告诉 NBC 新闻，他听到一名女子大喊：“有人在驾驶舱里刺伤了某人。”

paras.en: The plane then started shaking, with the aircraft briefly diving “toward the ground,” Cohen Or, 70, from central Israel, said. Someone then broke into the cockpit and said both the pilot and co-pilot had been stabbed, he added.
paras.zh: 来自以色列中部的 70 岁科恩·奥尔 (Cohen Or) 说，随后飞机开始摇晃，飞机短暂地“向地面”俯冲。他补充说，随后有人闯入驾驶舱，称飞行员和副驾驶均被刺伤。

paras.en: An assailant was subdued and a pilot who was onboard was able to “take control” of the plane, Cohen Or said. NBC News was not immediately able to independently verify his account.
paras.zh: 科恩·奥尔说，一名袭击者被制服，机上一名飞行员“控制”了飞机。 NBC 新闻无法立即独立核实他的账户。

paras.en: Israeli media, including The Times of Israel and Ynet, cited unidentified security officials as saying that the alert was triggered after an altercation between the plane’s two pilots.
paras.zh: 包括《以色列时报》和《Ynet》在内的以色列媒体援引身份不明的安全官员的话说，警报是在飞机的两名飞行员发生争执后触发的。

paras.en: Cluster2, which operates at several airports across Saudi Arabia, said both the captain and the first officer of Flydubai Flight 1073 had been injured and taken to a hospital after landing.
paras.zh: 在沙特阿拉伯多个机场运营的 Cluster2 表示，Flydubai 1073 航班的机长和副驾驶均受伤，在着陆后被送往医院。

paras.en: Video from onboard the Boeing 737 appeared to show two people lying on the floor, visibly bloodied as others crowd around them.
paras.zh: 波音 737 飞机上的视频似乎显示，两人躺在地板上，明显血迹斑斑，其他人围在他们周围。

paras.en: The mother of another passenger told NBC News that her daughter had feared for her life as the plane “started to go down and to shake.”
paras.zh: 另一位乘客的母亲告诉 NBC 新闻，当飞机“开始下降并摇晃”时，她的女儿非常担心自己的生命安全。

paras.en: Yasmin Abukasis said her daughter, Miriam Shira, said a pilot had been wounded, and that one of the pilots had a knife.
paras.zh: 亚斯明·阿布卡西斯 (Yasmin Abukasis) 说，她的女儿米里亚姆·希拉 (Miriam Shira) 说，一名飞行员受伤，其中一名飞行员拿着刀。

paras.en: NBC News was not immediately able to independently confirm details of the incident.
paras.zh: NBC 新闻未能立即独立确认该事件的细节。

paras.en: Abukasis said her daughter had described the ordeal as “crazy, like a movie.”
paras.zh: 阿布卡西斯说，她的女儿将这次磨难描述为“疯狂，就像电影一样”。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Flydubai said Flight FZ 1073 had “experienced an incident while en route” from Dubai International Airport to Ben Gurion International Airport.
paras.zh: Flydubai 的发言人表示，FZ 1073 航班在从迪拜国际机场飞往本古里安国际机场的“途中”发生了事故。

paras.en: The aircraft landed safely at the Prince Sultan bin Abdulaziz International Airport, known as Tabuk Airport, they said.
paras.zh: 他们说，飞机安全降落在苏丹本阿卜杜勒阿齐兹亲王国际机场，即塔布克机场。

paras.en: The airline was working to secure a replacement aircraft, and investigators were looking into what happened onboard.
paras.zh: 该航空公司正在努力寻找一架替代飞机，调查人员正在调查机上发生的情况。

paras.en: The Flydubai flight initially triggered a 7700 “general emergency” signal, aviation tracking site Flightradar24 reported. It then switched to a 7500 code, suggesting “unlawful interference,” before switching back to a 7700, the tracking site said.
paras.zh: 据航空跟踪网站 Flightradar24 报道，Flydubai 航班最初触发了 7700“一般紧急”信号。该跟踪网站称，随后它切换到 7500 代码，暗示存在“非法干扰”，然后又切换回 7700。

paras.en: It said “extreme fluctuations” were observed in the altitude data transmitted from the flight, which appeared to drop by 14,125 feet in just 29 seconds, according to Flightradar24.
paras.zh: 据 Flightradar24 称，该航班传输的高度数据出现“极端波动”，在短短 29 秒内似乎下降了 14,125 英尺。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the Israel Airports Authority said in a statement that it had opened a waiting and information area at Ben Gurion Airport for passengers’ families.
paras.zh: 以色列机场管理局发言人在一份声明中表示，已在本古里安机场为乘客家属开设了等候和信息区。

paras.en: The spokesperson said family members would continue to be updated “as the situation develops.”
paras.zh: 该发言人表示，“随着情况的发展”，将继续向家人通报最新情况。

paras.en: Earlier, U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee expressed relief in a post on X that the incident didn’t turn out to be “more serious.”
paras.zh: 早些时候，美国驻以色列大使迈克·哈卡比 (Mike Huckabee) 在 X 上发帖表示宽慰，称事件并未变得“更严重”。

paras.en: “This had everyone in the Middle East (esp Israel) on FULL ALERT this morning,” he said. “Having pilots inflight detouring to ‘fist city’ not your ordinary experience.”
paras.zh: “今天早上，中东（尤其是以色列）的每个人都处于高度戒备状态，”他说。 “让飞行员在飞行中绕道前往‘拳头城市’不是你平常的经历。”

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s office said he held consultations on the matter and had monitored developments.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的办公室表示，他就此事进行了磋商并关注事态发展。

paras.en: “The situation is under control, and all measures are currently being taken to bring the Israeli passengers back to Israel safely,” his office said Wednesday.
paras.zh: 他的办公室周三表示：“局势已得到控制，目前正在采取一切措施将以色列乘客安全带回以色列。”

articles.title: Jai Arrow told 'nothing' about pre-grand final tribute
articles.author: Henry Hanson and Myles Houlbrook-Walk

paras.en: Jai Arrow says he has been told "nothing" about a tribute awaiting him ahead of Sunday's NRL grand final.
paras.zh: 贾伊·阿罗 (Jai Arrow) 表示，他“没有被告知”周日 NRL 总决赛之前将有一场致敬活动。

paras.en: It was widely reported today that Arrow would do a lap of Stadium Australia while a selection of Australian musicians perform Gerry and the Pacemakers' song and Liverpool FC anthem You'll Never Walk Alone.
paras.zh: 今天广泛报道称，阿罗将在澳大利亚体育场绕一圈，同时精选的澳大利亚音乐家将演奏格里和起搏者队的歌曲以及利物浦足球俱乐部的歌曲“你永远不会独行”。

paras.en: Speaking to the ABC at this evening's Dally M Awards in Sydney, Arrow said he was unsure of the details of the ceremony.
paras.zh: 阿罗在今晚于悉尼举行的 Dally M 颁奖典礼上接受澳大利亚广播公司采访时表示，他不确定颁奖典礼的细节。

paras.en: "[I know] nothing yet, apparently I'm going around … but I don't know anything," Arrow said.
paras.zh: “[我]什么都不知道，显然我正在四处走动......但我什么都不知道，”阿罗说。

paras.en: "So it'll be interesting. It won't just be for me, it'll be for everyone fighting MND."
paras.zh: “所以这会很有趣。这不仅适合我，也适合每个与 MND 作斗争的人。”

paras.en: Arrow was honoured with the Provan-Summons Medal at the awards night for embodying the spirit of the game, which is measured against the values of respect, honesty, bravery and sportsmanship.
paras.zh: 阿罗在颁奖之夜被授予普罗万-召唤奖章，因为它体现了这项运动的精神，这种精神是根据尊重、诚实、勇敢和体育精神的价值观来衡量的。

paras.en: He said the proposed pre-game tribute on Sunday would be an opportunity to continue raising awareness of MND.
paras.zh: 他表示周日拟议的赛前致敬将是一个继续提高 MND 意识的机会。

paras.en: "I can use my platform to spread awareness," he said.
paras.zh: “我可以利用我的平台来传播意识，”他说。

paras.en: Meanwhile, NRL executive chairman Peter V'landys was tight-lipped about the tribute but promised fans they would be "happy and impressed" with the performers selected.
paras.zh: 与此同时，NRL 执行主席彼得·维兰迪斯 (Peter V'landys) 对此次致敬守口如瓶，但向粉丝们承诺，他们会对所选表演者感到“高兴和印象深刻”。

paras.en: "You'll see, there'll be superstar Australian performers, that's all that we'll say, and everyone will be very happy and impressed with what we've got," he said.
paras.zh: “你会看到，将会有澳大利亚超级明星表演者，这就是我们要说的，每个人都会对我们所拥有的感到非常高兴和印象深刻，”他说。

paras.en: "But it's not about them; it's about Jai, it's about what Jai does; he inspires people.
paras.zh: “但这不是关于他们；而是关于 Jai，这是关于 Jai 所做的事情；他激励着人们。

paras.en: "We've received a lot of correspondence at the NRL about how his inspiration has made them see their illnesses through."
paras.zh: “我们在 NRL 收到了很多信件，讲述他的灵感如何让他们看清自己的疾病。”

paras.en: V'landys also said the league will be donating $100,000 to Arrow's family, as well as $1 million to a "fund for underprivileged kids who can't afford to play rugby league".
paras.zh: 维兰迪斯还表示，联盟将向阿罗的家人捐赠 10 万美元，并向“为无力参加橄榄球联盟的贫困儿童提供的基金”捐赠 100 万美元。

paras.en: "If we can lift a lot of other people with Jai's courage and leadership, that's what we're going to do on Sunday night," V'landys said.
paras.zh: 维兰迪斯说：“如果我们能够以杰的勇气和领导力来鼓舞很多人，那就是我们周日晚上要做的事情。”

articles.title: After 10-year probe, police want 54 people charged over Grenfell Tower blaze
articles.author: Mazoe Ford and Syan Vallance

paras.en: Almost a decade since London's deadly Grenfell Tower fire disaster, police have asked prosecutors to consider charging 54 people and 20 companies and organisations.
paras.zh: 伦敦格伦菲尔大厦致命火灾发生近十年后，警方已要求检察官考虑对 54 人以及 20 家公司和组织提出指控。

paras.en: Seventy-two people died, including 18 children, after a refrigerator electrical fault sparked a fire that ripped through the 23-storey social housing building in North Kensington in June 2017.
paras.zh: 2017 年 6 月，冰箱电气故障引发火灾，烧毁北肯辛顿 23 层社会住房大楼，造成 72 人死亡，其中包括 18 名儿童。

paras.en: The public inquiry's final report in 2024 blamed the disaster on failings by the government, the construction industry and, most of all, the companies involved in fitting the exterior with flammable cladding that had been marketed as safe.
paras.zh: 公共调查 2024 年的最终报告将这场灾难归咎于政府、建筑行业，以及最重要的是，参与安装易燃包层的公司的失误，而这些包层在市场上被宣传为安全的。

paras.en: Senior police had said no criminal charges would be brought while the inquiry was underway.
paras.zh: 高级警方表示，调查进行期间不会提出刑事指控。

paras.en: Now, two years after its completion, the Metropolitan Police said it had asked the Crown Prosecution Service to consider charges including corporate manslaughter, gross negligence manslaughter, health and safety offences, fraud and fraud-related offences and misconduct in public office.
paras.zh: 现在，在完成两年后，大都会警察局表示，已要求皇家检察署考虑指控，包括公司过失杀人、重大过失杀人、健康和安全犯罪、欺诈和欺诈相关犯罪以及公职人员不当行为。

paras.en: Police have also submitted all their evidence files to prosecutors.
paras.zh: 警方还向检察官提交了所有证据档案。

paras.en: Survivors and victims' families say it is a long-overdue but important milestone, which they hope will lead to prosecutions.
paras.zh: 幸存者和受害者家属表示，这是一个迟来但重要的里程碑，他们希望这将导致起诉。

paras.en: "It's disappointing it's taken this long. I mean it's nearly 10 years on and there's been no accountability, no charges, nothing's really changed if I'm brutally honest," survivor Marcio Gomes told the ABC.
paras.zh: 幸存者马西奥·戈麦斯告诉美国广播公司：“花了这么长时间才令人失望。我的意思是，已经过去近十年了，没有任何责任，没有任何指控，如果我说实话，一切都没有真正改变。”

paras.en: "Having said that, I know forensic elements do take time, so I would prefer they get things right rather than rushing a few things and then all of a sudden certain people can't get prosecuted because [police have] done things not quite in the right way."
paras.zh: “话虽如此，我知道法证人员确实需要时间，所以我更希望他们把事情做好，而不是仓促完成一些事情，然后突然间某些人无法被起诉，因为[警察]做事的方式不太正确。”

paras.en: Mr Gomes, who lived on the 21st floor, is the father of Grenfell's youngest victim; his baby boy Logan was stillborn while his wife Andreia lay in a coma in the days after the fire. She survived.
paras.zh: 住在 21 楼的戈麦斯先生是格伦菲尔最小受害者的父亲；火灾发生后几天，他的男婴洛根死产，而他的妻子安德烈娅则处于昏迷状态。她活了下来。

paras.en: The couple's two daughters, Luana and Megan, were also in a coma and survived.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇的两个女儿卢安娜和梅根也处于昏迷状态，但幸存下来。

paras.en: Mr Gomes said he wanted prosecutors to review the evidence thoroughly and "throw the book" at those they find to be responsible because they had "blood on their hands".
paras.zh: 戈麦斯表示，他希望检察官彻底审查证据，并向那些认为负有责任的人“惩罚”，因为他们“手上沾满了鲜血”。

paras.en: Police have said the investigation has taken time because it has been "immense".
paras.zh: 警方表示，调查需要时间，因为调查规模“巨大”。

paras.en: Officers have analysed about 27,000 pieces of evidence and gathered 14,400 witness statements.
paras.zh: 官员们分析了约 27,000 份证据并收集了 14,400 份证人证词。

paras.en: Deputy Assistant Commissioner Kevin Southworth said it was a "milestone moment" in the police investigation.
paras.zh: 副助理局长凯文·索斯沃斯 (Kevin Southworth) 表示，这是警方调查的“里程碑时刻”。

paras.en: "We appreciate, of course, it has taken nine years to get to this point. As we have said before, this is one of the most complex investigations ever undertaken by any UK law enforcement agency. The scale is truly enormous," he said.
paras.zh: “当然，我们很感激，花了九年时间才走到这一步。正如我们之前所说，这是英国执法机构有史以来进行的最复杂的调查之一。规模确实巨大，”他说。

paras.en: "While we know this has had a significant impact on those waiting for answers, it has necessarily taken this long to ensure our investigation is meticulous and presents the very best possible evidence to the CPS for charging decisions."
paras.zh: “虽然我们知道这对那些等待答案的人产生了重大影响，但我们必然需要这么长时间才能确保我们的调查是细致的，并向 CPS 提供最好的证据以做出指控决定。”

paras.en: The CPS has committed to making the charging decisions before the 10th anniversary of the fire in June 2027. Any trials would be among the most complex in British history and could take years to get underway.
paras.zh: CPS 承诺在 2027 年 6 月火灾十周年之前做出指控决定。任何试验都将是英国历史上最复杂的试验之一，可能需要数年时间才能开始。

paras.en: "It's been deeply frustrating. I would kind of almost use the word tortuous. It's just so painful having to wait so long," Grenfell survivor and campaigner Ed Daffarn told the ABC, adding that it was "particularly galling" the alleged perpetrators had been "able to get on with their lives" since the blaze.
paras.zh: 格伦菲尔幸存者、活动人士埃德·达法恩 (Ed Daffarn) 告诉美国广播公司：“这真是令人沮丧。我几乎要用“曲折”这个词。等待这么久真是太痛苦了。”他补充说，自火灾发生以来，被指控的肇事者“能够继续生活”，这“特别令人难堪”。

paras.en: Journalist Peter Apps has published a book on the disaster.
paras.zh: 记者彼得·阿普斯出版了一本有关这场灾难的书。

paras.en: "I think it's hard not to be surprised, when you put all the evidence together about Grenfell, how much was known by so many people," Apps said.
paras.zh: “我认为，当你把所有关于格伦菲尔的证据放在一起时，你很难不感到惊讶，这么多人都知道多少，”阿普斯说。

paras.en: "There were many different parties who could have prevented this, and they had the information they needed to, which is why the inquiry, in the end, said every single death at Grenfell Tower was avoidable.
paras.zh: “有许多不同的团体本可以阻止这种情况发生，而且他们拥有所需的信息，这就是为什么调查最终表示格伦菲尔大厦的每一起死亡都是可以避免的。

paras.en: "You just needed people to act on what they knew."
paras.zh: “你只需要人们按照他们所知道的采取行动。”

paras.en: Highly combustible cladding made of plastic and aluminium on the side of the Grenfell Tower meant the fire spread rapidly.
paras.zh: 格伦菲尔塔侧面由塑料和铝制成的高度易燃包层意味着火势迅速蔓延。

paras.en: It remains on buildings around the world today, including in Australia.
paras.zh: 如今，它仍然存在于世界各地的建筑物上，包括澳大利亚。

paras.en: "This was a global issue because these are global companies and multinational companies who are selling this product through global supply chains," Apps said.
paras.zh: 阿普斯说：“这是一个全球性问题，因为这些跨国公司和跨国公司通过全球供应链销售这种产品。”

paras.en: Remediation work on buildings with flammable cladding across Australia is ongoing.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚各地对易燃包层建筑物的修复工作正在进行中。

paras.en: The fire was Britain's deadliest in a residential building since World War II and prompted a national reckoning over building standards and the safety and conditions of social housing for low-income communities.
paras.zh: 这场火灾是英国自二战以来最严重的住宅楼火灾，促使全国范围内对低收入社区的建筑标准以及社会住房的安全和条件进行反思。

paras.en: Mr Daffarn had flagged concerns about building maintenance and fire safety with building management and the local council before the fire.
paras.zh: 火灾发生前，达法恩先生已向建筑管理部门和当地议会表达了对建筑维护和消防安全的担忧。

paras.en: "As I stood underneath the smouldering embers of Grenfell Tower in the days after the fire, I was convinced that it would be the catalyst for change, for proper change," Mr Daffarn said.
paras.zh: 达法恩先生说：“火灾发生后的几天里，当我站在格伦菲尔大厦阴燃的余烬下时，我确信这将成为变革的催化剂，真正的变革。”

paras.en: "[But] standing here nearly 10 years after that event, I'm very sad to say that that change has not really occurred.
paras.zh: “[但是]在那次事件发生近十年后，我站在这里，我非常遗憾地说，这种变化并没有真正发生。

paras.en: "It wouldn't be right to say no lessons have been learned, because some lessons have been learned, but people in social housing are still not treated with dignity and respect, there are still people up and down the UK living in dangerous buildings, and the construction industry has not reformed itself in the way that it needs to."
paras.zh: “说没有吸取教训是不对的，因为已经吸取了一些教训，但社会住房中的人们仍然没有得到尊严和尊重，英国上下仍然有人住在危险的建筑里，建筑业也没有按照需要的方式进行自我改革。”

paras.en: Grenfell Tower is being demolished, but police are building replicas of parts of it to help future judges and juries understand what happened and who might be to blame.
paras.zh: 格伦菲尔大厦正在被拆除，但警方正在建造其部分复制品，以帮助未来的法官和陪审团了解发生了什么以及谁可能应该受到指责。

paras.en: Mr Gomes fought back tears as he told the ABC he felt compelled to keep campaigning for Grenfell survivors and victims' families for two reasons: to honour the memory of baby Logan and push for change.
paras.zh: 戈麦斯强忍着泪水告诉美国广播公司，他感到有必要继续为格伦菲尔幸存者和受害者家属开展活动，原因有两个：纪念婴儿洛根并推动变革。

paras.en: "There's still a lot of work to be done to make sure it never happens again," he said.
paras.zh: “为了确保这种情况不再发生，还有很多工作要做，”他说。

articles.title: 'Extraordinarly reckless': Prince Harry says children targeted by paparazzi

paras.en: Prince Harry's children targeted by 'European paparazzi' while at school in England, his spokesman says
paras.zh: 哈里王子的发言人称，他的孩子在英国上学时成为“欧洲狗仔队”的目标

paras.en: Prince Harry's children have been stalked by "certain European paparazzi" while at school in the English countryside, his spokesperson says.
paras.zh: 哈里王子的发言人表示，他的孩子们在英国乡村上学时遭到“某些欧洲狗仔队”的跟踪。

paras.en: Photographers reportedly walked the perimeter of Archie and Lilibet's new school before stopping to look in the grounds and monitor the royal children there.
paras.zh: 据报道，摄影师们在阿奇和莉莉贝特的新学校周围走了一圈，然后停下来观察校园并监视那里的王室孩子们。

paras.en: It marks the latest security issue plaguing the Duke and Duchess of Sussex since their return to Britain from California last month.
paras.zh: 这是自上个月从加利福尼亚返回英国以来困扰苏塞克斯公爵和公爵夫人的最新安全问题。

articles.title: Russian airstrikes kill at least 4 in Kyiv region, including child, Ukraine officials say

paras.en: Russian airstrikes kill at least 4 in Kyiv region, including child, Ukraine officials say
Meanwhile, fighter jets were scrambled as a drone entered Moldova's airspace
Russian drone and missile attacks on Kyiv and nearby areas killed four people, damaged energy infrastructure and shrouded the capital in smoke, Ukrainian officials said Wednesday.

Two women and a 14-year-old child died in overnight strikes on the Ukrainian capital and a town on its northern outskirts. Another person was killed in an attack on a Kyiv warehouse, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that five people had died overall, though details on the additional death were not immediately clear.

Russia acknowledged the massive overnight assault, saying it had hit a data centre in the capital supporting Ukraine's armed forces, various power plants in the Kyiv region, an industrial complex in Odesa region and port infrastructure in Izmail.
Ukraine's air force said that Moscow had deployed anti-ship and ballistic missiles and 188 drones, with five missiles and 155 drones intercepted.

Zelenskyy said Ukraine — which is also short of interceptors to down ballistic missiles — had received new air defence support packages in recent days. Thanking allies for the deliveries, he called for more protection ahead of the winter.
Ukraine Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi said on Telegram that "a combined strike of this scale hasn't happened since the end of last heating season."
"Since summer, there's barely been a day without an attack on our energy infrastructure," he said.
Power company DTEK did not detail the damage to energy infrastructure in Kyiv but said workers had restored supply to 8,000 households.
On Wednesday morning, Kyiv was shrouded in thick fog from the smoke of attacks. Emergency services asked residents to keep windows closed.
- Why is it so difficult for Ukraine to take down Russia's jet-powered drones?
paras.zh: - 为什么乌克兰击落俄罗斯喷气式无人机如此困难？

paras.en: - Ukraine uses drones to make airdrops of aid to occupied city of Oleshky on brink of starvation
Citing preliminary information, Klitschko said debris had been found at a Western embassy in the centre of Kyiv. He did not specify which embassy.
Ukraine is expecting another winter assault on power and heating facilities after entire cities were plunged into darkness and cold for days or weeks last year.

Among neighbouring nations, a drone crossed into Moldova's airspace and exploded near the eastern village of Hirbovat, while European Union and NATO members Romania and Poland both scrambled military jets, the countries said.
paras.zh: 这些国家表示，在邻国中，一架无人机进入摩尔多瓦领空，并在东部村庄希尔博瓦特附近爆炸，欧盟和北约成员国罗马尼亚和波兰均紧急紧急升空军用飞机。

paras.en: Flights at Polish airports Lublin and Rzeszow were temporarily suspended.
Ukraine has also increased attacks on Russia, hitting refineries and online retailers to undermine Moscow's war effort.

One person was killed in drone attacks in Russia's Bryansk region, which borders Ukraine, while a Ukrainian drone attack on the oil-producing Samara region damaged private houses, regional governors said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯与乌克兰接壤的布良斯克地区的无人机袭击造成一人死亡，而乌克兰无人机对产油萨马拉地区的袭击造成私人房屋受损，地区州长表示。

paras.en: Russia has extended its ban on diesel exports for fuel producers until the end of October, the government said Wednesday, adding further strain to a global energy market already rattled by ongoing conflicts and supply shortages.
Russia has repeatedly imposed curbs on gasoline and diesel exports to rein in rising fuel prices and tackle shortages triggered by Ukrainian drone attacks on oil refineries.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯多次对汽油和柴油出口实施限制，以遏制燃油价格上涨，并解决乌克兰无人机袭击炼油厂引发的短缺问题。

paras.en: Two weeks ago, U.S. President Donald Trump announced on social media that Ukraine and Russia were agreeing to a limited ceasefire. While the warring sides expressed some support for the concept, there was no evidence a deal had been reached, and the attacks have continued.

articles.title: FlyDubai flight en route to Israel descends rapidly, after reported disturbance in cockpit

paras.en: FlyDubai flight en route to Israel descends rapidly, after reported disturbance in cockpit
Tabuk airport in Saudi Arabia says both pilots were hospitalized

The Israeli government believes an incident on a flight from the United Arab Emirates to Israel, which diverted to Saudi Arabia after transmitting emergency signals on Wednesday, may have been an attempted "terror attack" by one of the pilots, according to two Israeli officials.
The two Israeli officials said the co-pilot was believed to have stabbed the captain before cabin crew entered the cockpit and took control of the plane.

The two officials, speaking on the condition of anonymity to brief reporters, said Israel's current assessment is that the incident was an attempted "terror attack" and not related to any kind of mental health issue with either of the pilots.

Around the time the plane landed at Tabuk Airport in northwestern Saudi Arabia, Doron Spielman, a spokesperson for the Israeli prime minister's office, told Reuters the incident was not believed to have been a hijacking, describing it as a "different incident."
The office said that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu had been briefed on the incident and was monitoring developments.
Tabuk Airport said that both pilots had been hospitalized after sustaining injuries.

FlyDubai Flight FZ 1073, from Dubai to Tel Aviv, diverted over Jordanian airspace toward Saudi Arabia, transmitting a general emergency signal and then another emergency signal that indicated possible unlawful interference several minutes later, according to flight-tracking website Flightradar24.

The emergency signals triggered a major security response in Israel, which has no official diplomatic relations with Saudi Arabia, where the plane landed. The incident highlighted the potential risks on a route that has become popular among Israeli nationals since the U.A.E. and Israel normalized ties six years ago in 2020.
The aircraft's data appeared to show that it had suddenly and rapidly descended by nearly 14,000 feet in less than 30 seconds before the first emergency signal, Flightradar24 said.
Israeli media reported that around 150 Israeli passengers were on board the Boeing 737 plane.

An airline spokesperson said the FlyDubai flight experienced an "incident" en route to Tel Aviv and diverted to Tabuk, where it landed safely. All passengers were safe and accounted for, the spokesperson said, without providing any further details.
The U.A.E. had yet to comment on the incident.
paras.zh: 阿联酋尚未对事件发表评论。

paras.en: Yasmin Abu Kasis said her daughter Miriam, who was among the passengers on the flight, had told her that she had heard screaming and that a man holding a knife had forced one of the pilots onto the floor, and that there was blood everywhere.
Israeli media published a photo purportedly taken from inside the plane, which appeared to show a passenger's blood-soaked shirt. Reuters could not immediately verify the image.
In a statement, the Israeli prime minister's office said the situation was "under control" and that all measures were being taken to bring the Israeli passengers back to Israel.
FlyDubai is the lower-cost sister carrier of Emirates airlines. It operates daily return flights between Dubai and Tel Aviv and normally uses airspace over Saudi Arabia and Jordan.

The low-cost carrier's fleet relies entirely on variants of the 737, a twin-engine, single-aisle aircraft that is widely used by airlines around the world. It has nearly 100 of the planes, including 69 of the Max 8 variant.
paras.zh: 这家低成本航空公司的机队完全依赖 737 的改型，这是一种双引擎、单通道飞机，被世界各地的航空公司广泛使用。它拥有近 100 架飞机，其中包括 69 架 Max 8 变体。

articles.title: Eiffel Tower chief to step down after female staff excluded during Hindu delegation visit

paras.en: Eiffel Tower chief to step down after female staff excluded during Hindu delegation visit
Group, known as BAPS, says it never requested female employees be hidden
The head of the company that runs the Eiffel Tower will step down at the end of the year after female staff at the landmark building in Paris were excluded during a visit by a Hindu religious group.

Patrick Branco Ruivo, director general of the Société d'Exploitation de la tour Eiffel, will leave his post after an investigation conducted by an independent firm uncovered a series of operational failures in relation to the visit on Sept. 5.
The failures resulted "in female staff being excluded from the visit that day, an unacceptable situation," a company statement on Tuesday said. Ruivo was appointed at the end of 2018.
The Eiffel Tower, which attracts seven million visitors a year, was closed on Sept. 7 due to a staff strike in protest over what a union official described as "unacceptable" management instructions.

Anger grew among staff of the 330-metre iconic landmark after management told employees that female workers should not be in contact with the delegation from Bochasanwasi Shri Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha.

The group, known as BAPS, is a worldwide religious and civic organization within the Swaminarayan sect, a branch of Hinduism. It had been holding celebrations to mark the inauguration of a traditional Hindu stone temple in the Paris region.
BAPS said in a statement to The Associated Press that the group "never requested that female employees be hidden, removed or excluded from the visit."

"The religious practices of our monks were explained to the Eiffel Tower's management in advance. These are personal spiritual commitments, which our monks observe without seeking to impose them on others.
"They do not require women to be excluded from the places they visit," the statement said. The group did not elaborate on what the monks' practices are.
Ariel Weil, the operating company's chair, said on Tuesday he has requested measures and training programs promoting gender equality to be implemented.

It was not the first time the 137-year-old tower has been closed by industrial action. It was shut for six days in February 2024 because of striking employees demanding better maintenance of the historic landmark, and higher wages.

articles.title: South Korea: Lost shark draws over half a million visitors

paras.en: A shark stranded in a canal in the northern port city of Busan has become South Korea's latest celebrity, tourist magnet and ambassador, as authorities' attempts to guide it back out to sea have so far faltered.
What do we know about the stranded shark?
The shark was first spotted in a narrow waterway in Busan's North Port on September 18.
Reports on its possible species vary but seem to suggest it's a type of requiem shark, possibly a bull shark or a bronze whaler.
It's a fairly large shark, appearing to be roughly 3.5 meters (around 11 feet, 6 inches) long.
It's been nicknamed "Bukangi," derived from the Korean name for the North Port in Busan, Buk Hang.
Busan city authorities say roughly 600,000 people have flocked to see the creature over the past two weeks.

During the four-day Chuseok bank holiday weekend, Busan city authorities said that almost half a million people visited the waterfront park where the shark was stranded, compared to an average of around 2,000 visitors on weekends.
City Mayor Chun Jae-soo thanked the involuntary visitor for publicity that would otherwise have cost "trillions."
Local media reported a spike in sales of shark-shaped ice creams at nearby stores.
The city named the lost predator an honorary ambassador after 91% of participants in a social media poll approved of the notion.
Shares in the Pinkfong Company, the studio behind the viral "Baby Shark" song, also rose by around 7% at one point amid the hype.
The excitement has also led to false rumors of a second sighting, or even of it being the shark's own spawn, with AI-generated dross inevitably following.
How are authorities trying to guide it back out to sea?
A rescue operation earlier this week failed.
The Coast Guard and other agencies deployed vessels that sprayed jets of water behind the shark, trying to encourage it to swim back towards the ocean.
Instead the shark simply evaded the streams without heading in the desired direction.
South Korea's Chosun Daily newspaper reported that a fresh attempt, this time seeking to use a net to guide the shark out, was being planned for Friday.

The shark is the latest unlikely animal celebrity craze to grip South Korea, not least following the excitement in April over Neukgu, a young wolf that escaped from a zoo. It spent nine days at large before being recaptured.

The incident is also somewhat reminiscent of the German frenzy this year over a beached humpback whale, who was in turn given the place-based nickname of "Timmy" — after the Timmendorfer Strand beach on the Baltic coast, the site of its first stranding.
